clean_body: Business Emergency for Connecticut's Future | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Goldstein For Congress - Please Subscribe and also visit us at www.goldsteinforcongress.com Business Emergency for Connecticut's Future | | and | Jan 22 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- According to a recent , Connecticut ranks 47th out of 50 states for starting a business. That is not a talking point -- it is an alarm bell. The findings were highlighted locally in a and paint a bleak picture that every employer, entrepreneur, and worker in Connecticut already feels on the ground. Why Connecticut Is Near the Bottom? WalletHub evaluated all 50 states using real-world business conditions, not political slogans. Among the factors that it evaluated that are dragging Connecticut down: 47th in average growth in the number of small businesses 43rd in office space affordability 43rd in labor costs 35th in availability of human capital 43rd in average length of the work week 44th in cost of living 38th in industry variety This is not just a cost problem. It is a workforce problem. The Human Capital Crisis Availability of human capital should be Connecticut's strength. We were the state that at one time that dominated the space race and excelled in national defense. Instead, it is one of our biggest weaknesses. We do not need an economy built around remote Zoom jobs for New Yorkers in 15 minute cities -- effectively turning Connecticut into a sanctuary state for people escaping the consequences of policies they voted for in New York City and Albany. We need: A trained and trainable workforce Career pipelines tied to real industries Trades, manufacturing, logistics, construction, healthcare, and technology rooted in Connecticut Shockingly, Connecticut is now worse than New York when it comes to starting a business. That should be unthinkable but given a one-party system it is not a shock. Bad governance starts from our Congressional representatives and Governor and cascades all the way to the local level. Affordability Is on the Ballot This November, affordability is on the ballot -- and that includes business affordability. For employers, affordability means: The ability to hire local workers at sustainable wages Lower operating expenses , including utilities and energy Predictable regulatory environments that reward investment instead of punishing it Instead, Connecticut businesses are being crushed by: Sky-high electricity rates - the 3rd Worst in the Nation "Public benefit" charges that act like hidden taxes Failed green energy mandates, including offshore wind policies that have raised costs without delivering reliability as they could not go online in time and on budget - it was budgeted for 1.5 Billion and now exceeds 6.2 Billion () These policies do not just hurt residents -- they bleed employers dry. A Choice, Not an Accident Connecticut's ranking is not accidental. It is the result of years of policy choices that prioritize ideology over outcomes. It is also not surprising that 9 of the 10 best states for business have Republican Governors. A Republican Governor and A Republican Controlled State Government is Needed in Connecticut this November. | | ---|---|--- California Rounds Out the Top 10 It is surprising that this Report ranked California in the top 10 which goes to show that as crazy as we think California is, Connecticut is worse. Call to Action - Business and Opportunity is On the Ballot This November You cannot tax, regulate, and energy-price your way into prosperity. If Connecticut wants jobs, growth, and opportunity -- not empty storefronts and outbound moving vans -- then voters must recognize what is truly at stake. This November, business is on the ballot. | A guest post by| Consultant, Political Consultant, Campaign Manager, Construction Consultant and Corporate Attorney. Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just _crushing_ Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. _They don’t even believe us._
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
**This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.**
So I am asking:

Peter,
Congressional leaders just introduced a bipartisan bill to triple ICE's budget. The vote is today.
They want an $18 billion plus-up when ICE agents are ripping American citizens out of their cars, carrying out violent arrests, and using deadly force with no accountability. This is a moral disgrace.

**By Wendy M. Yurgo**
Yesterday in _The Reckoning_ , we ran the numbers on President Trump's first year back: border encounters down more than 80 percent, U.S. energy production surging with oil at record levels and gas hovering around $2.78 a gallon, job growth slower than we'd like, and deficits still too high. That was the domestic scorecard.
Then President Trump took it straight to the World Economic Forum in Davos and turned the global stage into a reckoning of its own.
He walked into a room packed with global elites and delivered over an hour of unvarnished America First reality: U.S. economic wins, ungrateful allies, and a blunt case for bringing Greenland under American control. The reaction was telling. It started with laughter. It ended with gasps, long silences, nervous chuckles, and a few early exits. Even Finnish President Alexander Stubb looked like he'd seen a ghost.
This wasn't a polite panel discussion.
It was a confrontation.
This is the one-year scorecard. No spin. No excuses. Just results.

## **Greenland: Not Fascism --Strategy, Security, and 150 Years in the Making**
President Trump referred to Greenland as "our territory," framing it as essential to North American security. He was blunt: no other country can adequately protect it. He pointed to World War II, noting that Denmark fell to Germany in six hours, after which the United States assumed responsibility for Greenland's defense.
Trump characterized this period as the U.S. stepping in to protect Greenland and then "giving it back." Historically, Greenland remained Danish sovereign territory throughout. That distinction matters, because it makes clear this debate isn't about historical ownership, but about how history is invoked to justify U.S. leverage today.
Trump was equally clear on what he would not do. Despite critics fixating on verbal slips, he mistakenly said "Iceland" a few times; his position was unmistakable: "I won't use force. I don't want to use force."
Hours later, following discussions with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, President Trump announced a framework for a future Greenland and Arctic deal. At the same time, he dropped February tariff threats against Europe. Markets responded immediately, with the S&P jumping roughly 1.16 percent. Danish officials expressed relief that military force was ruled out, even while reiterating that Greenland is not for sale.
What the media largely ignored is that this conversation is not new. U.S. interest in Greenland dates back to 1867, when Secretary of State William Seward floated the idea shortly after acquiring Alaska from Russia. A land swap was discussed in 1910. In 1946, President Truman formally offered Denmark $100 million in gold. The motivation has always been strategic, not imperial.

* There's a massive global supply deficit.
* Insatiable demand fueled by A.I. and green energy,
* This has pushed the silver market to a breaking point.

With analysts forecasting an imminent move toward triple digits, the cost of waiting has never been higher. Help secure your position now, or watch from the sidelines as the most significant metal cycle in a generation potentially leaves you behind.
**The window is closing fast, so there 's no time to wait.**

* * *
_**Piece continues**_
And today, the stakes are higher. Russia has rebuilt Soviet-era Arctic bases and expanded military patrols. China operates "research stations" widely viewed as dual-use, pairing civilian research with military intelligence, and has conducted joint Arctic operations with Russia, including coordinated patrols. They want the shipping lanes, rare earth minerals, and long-term control of the region.
President Trump tied Greenland directly to America's future missile-defense architecture, including what he described as a "Golden Dome" system designed to protect North America from emerging threats. In that context, Greenland isn't about empire. It's about whether the United States or its adversaries control the high ground.
Trump came in hot, forced the issue, and emerged with a framework without firing a shot. That is leverage-driven negotiation while rivals are already circling.
## **The Grievances --and the Gasps**
Greenland wasn't the end of it.
President Trump tore into Europe, saying it is "not even recognizable" due to mass immigration and failed policies. He reminded the room that without America, "you'd all be speaking German and a little Japanese." He jabbed Switzerland as "only good because of us," mocked Emmanuel Macron's sunglasses, said Canada "lives because of the United States," and called out NATO freeloaders. He took shots at windmills, floated a one-year 10 percent cap on credit card interest rates, and warned against importing cultures that do not work.
The room grew visibly uncomfortable. Laughter evaporated. Gasps followed the sharper lines. Heads shook. Some attendees walked out early.
Predictably, the mainstream press branded the speech "antagonistic" and "rambling." But millions of Americans are tired of footing the bill while allies act entitled. President Trump said out loud what many Americans believe that U.S. power built much of the prosperity in that room, and it's time for fair terms.
## **What This Means for Us**
Davos revealed the same pattern seen in the first-year numbers: bold moves produce results, even when the delivery isn't polished. The Greenland framework and tariff walk-back advanced U.S. interests without escalation. Secure borders and lower energy costs are already helping businesses like mine.
That said, publicly dressing down allies could have downstream consequences on trade and job growth; something to watch closely in 2026.
I'm not here to defend every tangent or verbal slip. I'm here to recognize outcomes: a deal framework, no tariffs, and a stronger Arctic position. The elites gasped because someone finally challenged assumptions they've coasted on for decades.
Everyday Americans win when leadership puts this country first without apology.
**The reckoning isn 't finished.
It just went global.**

body:
It's never too early to start making your guesses. See if ours match your thoughts heading into this year's midterms. | | | |
---
| | | **Big Names Make News**
---
| “This was one of the closest house races in the country last cycle. [Rep. Scott] Perry only barely won reelection, despite the fact that [President Donald J.] Trump was carrying his district by about five points. That goes to show that Perry has some unique vulnerabilities that a generic republican incumbent might not have.” - Erin Covey, U.S. House of Representatives coverage lead [[Watch](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e6c7be2b8e&e=b7b3eddce2)]

“Last cycle, [Rep. Rob] Bresnahan was touted by Republicans as one of their top recruits at the House level. His background on paper certainly had some things that could have worked well for him. He had roots in the district. He was personally wealthy so he was able to self-fund, and he had a relatively moderate disposition and didn’t really run hard to the Right.” \- Erin Covey, U.S. House of Representatives coverage lead [[Watch](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=207d857796&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
| **Your early 2026 midterm predictions**
---
| In this episode of Voices of Reason, we’re joined by Erin Covey for a sharp look ahead to the 2026 midterm elections. Drawing on early indicators and election data, Covey walks through what may define the next election cycle — and which races could ultimately decide control in Washington.

We also explore what lessons from recent cycles still matter, what assumptions may be overstated, and where both parties could be misreading the terrain.

This episode offers a clear-eyed preview of the political road to 2026 — and why the midterms may be stranger, and more consequential, than many expect.

| Imagine this: You're sitting in a sterile doctor's office, heart pounding, as the words "bad news" hang in the air like a storm cloud. I've been there—a few times. In my latest video, I open up about my recent scary medical diagnosis, and how it echoes those gut-wrenching moments from my past where the outlook seemed bleak... until it wasn't. But here's the twist that turned my tears into triumph: I've experienced times when, what felt like an unbreakable truth shattered under the weight of something far greater—a miracle. Not the fairy-tale kind, but the real, divine intervention that reminds us: Our situations might scream "impossible," but God whispers a higher truth. He's the ultimate author, rewriting endings we never saw coming. If you're staring down your own storm right now—whether it's health woes, financial cliffs, broken relationships, or that nagging fear that won't let go—this video is my heartfelt gift to you. It's not just my story; it's a beacon of hope that miracles aren't reserved for ancient scrolls or someone else's life. They're possible for you, too, because God's love doesn't play favorites. Click here to watch now on **Youtube** : [https://youtu.be/Lw3PVZmImRc](https://RachelHamm.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2a4361c438b0f1b15ed7ec95&id=87d5036b9b&e=5fa0631807)

(It's only 25:44 minutes long, but the encouragement could last a lifetime.) Let's hold onto that higher truth together. What's one miracle you're believing for today? Feel free to email me and share—I'd love to pray with you. Email me @: rachelhamm@att.net

Hey Peter,

That tells you everything you need to know._

**Let me be clear:_when I said the National Guard should be on the table if our cities are in trouble, I meant protecting families, backing law enforcement, and restoring order._ Period.**

NC Newsline: Amid protests, NC elections board rejects campus voting sites and Sunday voting in several counties [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012226_1&amount=25]
We're now facing the repercussions of the partisan election takeover laws that went into effect at the end of 2024, Team.
To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites on several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. These new, highly partisan State Election Board members wouldn't even look the protestors in the eye or engage with their proposals. After the vote, Chairman Francis De Luca threatened to call the cops on students if they didn’t leave.
Need to better understand how this impacts young voters? Western Carolina University in Jackson County, for example, has had a polling place on campus since 2016 that’s been used in five general elections and four primaries, according to a document prepared for the board. The state board voted 3-2 to get rid of it.
Closing the campus voting site would not save money, but “ would create barriers to voting for young, rural residents ,” Jackson County Board member Betsy Swift told the state board. 64% of students don’t have vehicles to drive to the polling place, she said.
Without the on-campus site, the closest polling place for students will be a recreation center nearly two miles away. Students without transportation will have to walk along a four-lane highway and through a meadow to get there.
Voter suppression isn't just black and white photos of eligible voters being turned away from polling places. Voter suppression is making it harder for eligible voters to take part in our elections through onerous ID requirements, closing polling places, taking away voting locations, or ending mail-in voting. Every time someone makes it harder to cast your ballot, voters are suppressed.
It's not going to end until we stop them.

Peter, my name is Nancy Lacore, and I’m running for Congress in SC-01.
For years, Nancy Mace has put her own personal ambition ahead of South Carolinians. Instead of delivering for the folks who elected her, she’s more concerned with political theater and national headlines.
After 35 years of serving our country in the Navy, I’m running because I believe South Carolina’s First deserves leadership that’s focused on the real challenges people face every day.
But here’s the truth about this race, Peter: the first weeks matter most. The sooner we can get the word out and reach voters where they are, the better our momentum will be on Election Day.
Will you split a $10 or $20 donation between my campaign and Real Texas PAC? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-lacore?refcode=012126_1]
CHIP IN NOW >>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=012126_1]
Nancy Mace has spent her time in Congress chasing attention instead of solutions – changing her positions when it’s suited her and turning the struggles of South Carolina families into political bargaining chips. That kind of damage won’t just disappear on its own.
That’s why I’m answering the call to serve, Peter. I’ll bring the focus back to where it belongs: on integrity, service, and the everyday challenges facing South Carolinians. We can restore integrity to this seat, deliver accountable leadership, and finally make the government work for people.
But we need all hands on deck to make it right. If we wait, we risk losing out on this opportunity and giving it to yet another grifting career politician.
This is our chance to build something better for South Carolina. I’m ready to step up and do the work, but I need you to join me, Peter. Will you split a donation of $10 or more between my campaign and Real Texas PAC today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-lacore?refcode=012126_1]

| | |

Friend,
I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the United States Senate. My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker.
It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of antisemitism is part of my story – as it is for so many Jews who are too often made to feel like outsiders or that they are less than.
**_[Will you please make a gift of $5 or more now to help me continue to fight antisemitism in Washington and make positive change for all communities in Nevada and across the country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123818788/596667279/276511840?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5673-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDhkNDIyMS1hY2Y3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XiDfBOw93Yfday-UXKj--plXcxWdPbeRSp2-eKzPt3g=)_**

---
When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a swimming pool with my mom when a lifeguard on duty told her that we were “dirty” because we were Jewish – and that we had to leave the pool immediately because of it. My mom never forgot that interaction.
Nearly every Jewish American has had a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today.
Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. MULTIPLE deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters.
All of it is wrong, and addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. **That is why:**
* I founded the Senate’s first-ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism – which now includes more than half the Senate as members.

* I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Combat Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate.

* I introduced bipartisan legislation to address antisemitism on college campuses across the country.

* I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador.

* I introduced and successfully passed into law the reauthorization of the _Never Again Education Act_ , which helps educate our communities about the Holocaust.

* I recently led the charge to stop the Trump administration from weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas.

When I think about this work, I think about being that little girl with her mom again. Every day, I'm fighting to make our country a place where _nobody_ is targeted because of their faith or who they are – whether it’s a swimming pool, a house of worship, or the United States military.
We have made progress over the years in fighting back against antisemitism, but there is still so much more work for me to do – and your support helps power my fight in the Senate. Fellow Conservative,

When hardworking Minnesotans like you pay taxes to feed hungry children, the last thing we expect is for those funds to be used to buy luxury cars, overseas properties, and lavish lifestyles for scammers.

But that's precisely what happened right here in Minnesota with the Feeding Our Future scandal – over $250 million in federal child nutrition dollars stolen through fake claims, phony sites, and outright fraud.

As a retired Navy SEAL who's spent my life fighting for America and holding the line on accountability, I believe anyone who betrays our trust like this – especially if they're naturalized citizens – should face severe consequences, and illegal aliens need to be deported!

_**Should we deport any naturalized citizen who steals from the American taxpayer?**_

Prosecutors have already secured dozens of convictions, with assets including Porsches and millions of dollars in cash being seized. But **we need stronger laws to ensure this never happens again** and to send a clear message: Fraud against American taxpayers will not be tolerated.

The first step in this journey has been accomplished: Tim Walz is out of the governor’s race. This happened on his watch, and he did absolutely nothing to stop it.

David is the only Democratic candidate who has served as both a legislator and executive – and he brings a track record of bipartisan success in both settings. 2. As county executive, David has balanced million-dollar budgets, supported small businesses, and cut the county’s carbon emissions in half, all while delivering the largest property tax cut in county history. 3. David has delivered historic, bipartisan wins through a divided statehouse, setting a model of how Wisconsin’s next governor can get things done. Peter, today marks the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s landmark _Roe v. Wade_ decision, a ruling that once recognized reproductive freedom as a fundamental right. But instead of celebrating progress, we’re being reminded how quickly it can be taken away. Despite decades of precedent, a conservative Supreme Court, reshaped by Donald Trump, overturned _Roe,_ stripping millions of women of the right to make their own health care decisions. Since then, 13 states have enacted total abortion bans, putting lives at risk and forcing families into impossible situations. In 2023, the North Carolina General Assembly passed a 12 week abortion ban. Even with this legislation, North Carolina remains one of the least restrictive states in the South for reproductive rights. Valerie Foushee is committed to restoring the right to choose nationwide and protecting access to reproductive health care here at home. But this fight requires all of us to speak out. body:
#

Friends,
Exactly one year ago, Donald Trump shut down the Office of Gun Violence Prevention at the White House.
[](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_OfficeofGVP/?t=1&akid=11201%2E3935704%2EdgMNbn)
The Office of Gun Violence Prevention was a first-of-its-kind federal government effort to coordinate with states and federal officials to stop violence, invest in community intervention programs, respond to shootings, and support survivors.
After Donald Trump took office, one of the first pages to disappear from the White House’s website was the one for the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. It’s despicable.
The fact that Donald Trump dismantled this office is yet another example of how his allegiance to the gun lobby takes precedence over keeping our country safe from preventable gun violence.
We must speak out to demand a permanent federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.
[**If you agree that we must permanently reinstate the Office of Gun Violence Prevention, will you please add your name to our petition today? Help us send a message to Donald Trump and Republicans that we are ready to fight to end gun violence →**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_OfficeofGVP//?source=em260122-1-b&refcode2=11201.3935704.dgMNbn&akid=11201%2E3935704%2EdgMNbn)

Mexico City is my home. It's where I was born, where I learned to believe in God's purpose, and where I first saw the kind of poverty and pain that can break your heart.When I speak with our partners there, the stories of children in need make my heart ache.You may know me as the producer of the blockbuster film _Sound of Freedom._ But what you may not know is that the film became the foundation for a massive movement, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation.** A humanitarian organization that rescues children from sex trafficking, supports their recovery, and helps stop exploitation before it begins. In hospitals across Mexico city, vulnerable children, including those rescued from trafficking and abuse, are now fighting to survive. But there aren't enough ICU beds to care for them.Some lie on stretchers or floors, waiting for a chance at healing that may never come.That's why I've set a goal:

**I want to raise $20,000 to deliver $200,000 worth of ICU beds** to hospitals and medical centers that serve God's children in Mexico City.

Dear Friend of Truth,

Imagine waking up to this message from your high school:

"Vandalism to school property. Law enforcement has been contacted and we are cooperating with the investigation."

And now, imagine that message was aimed at YOU--because you got permission to paint your school's "spirit rock" with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk and the legacy he left to Christian youth.

[ SEND A MESSAGE OF SUPPORT](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/J3keIHKvlMC_aBxnQMZa_Qo67zpJ89CuqHBaPkOitczMcyUT5R2iuj-5FKaNeHBXxIVjfgkjN1GTT3QL1wa9b8yAGGYtm0erR6ItN0snAqDqHSvGj74AVImduUYITpcFiY_BQG6RstQnMBST6OElicoAFgpxteMISuPnWD6NDZCt6EIt0-k3uBExQ2WMm3vKi1TBXhMnBVby6TOJSFZAl3b4LgjJ0GcGWZKTLYrdR6wMY0ulXO1Dt5AOuLglhMvjHcg2-VOKYnMMPiocUU7gu52j4cCynM1c1q8sKWH8nuvlU6k1O3OWk3OXnRlaMm_VXt2gjCFOafnF7uZAKqh5pOinXxTbZJU3bE82_4Z94xXsqK8k8jL3nQjf8lKgA92qzZRdsoej148QsAGCnpVgW3VIIhszWCXD1XWnrUGyLPVnwpSJBK0FG_Rx2IQj4puqZ02PDfdHIFuoIE75ZfYYK2-WXny_M4q0LAs8YKVPyKiPyOdy0xwcGtPDrzI6G5e10hsZTOSLcA8EVFTi9ZZLYma7pzSCPNIHO53l67K1ZkauVG68oVdlkgT7KoyO3R7IGw9nZYC5xZdAp-z4xJ0kZtS66kCUCcQN3TpkVfC3LNrDBT7um6WDGtpmrYVqCBExkemdHc5a87-IxywlWdQgeDCoNCb2hDGDVVh_hNcubKGdXWQeSHzS_tv5klcBihKckhDRmJVRSjKmQWc3g36jJjlZqQ8oAmPb8-QC8BeahFIh6aWdNYs6V0Ke9gbpnrcYUq4C3dMIR3D6Res/iA0_-yngRKyOdXe2vNK1QxJueh92qTtO/17)

That's exactly what happened to Gabby Stout. She had expressly asked permission to paint the message--and the school had given it.

**But the next day, after she and her friends painted the rock with the messages "Freedom 1776" and "Live Like Kirk--John 11:25," school officials sent out a school-wide email accusing them of vandalism and launched a criminal investigation.**

And it got worse. The local news widely reported on the "vandalism" and "investigation"--and school officials hauled Gabby into an office and forced her to write a statement describing her actions and show them her phone logs.

School officials never obtained permission from her parents to go through her phone, nor did they inform her or her parents of her constitutional right to remain silent and contact an attorney during a criminal investigation.

The school punished Gabby--tried to silence her voice--yet officials had no problem supporting other student causes, including Black Lives Matter and protests against immigration enforcement. The hypocrisy couldn't be clearer.

Of course, [this student and her friends had NOT committed vandalism.](http://links.redconservatives.com/s/c/ZcZmfE_sOE724UsdN3nilHtVVYO7fUKMiosfVJlgPwMibTFAurrI2D7adB45mPqMBrTOKfNPdkyn0kIy0kg2Dc47wGgX12IOvvSEzZAspd2mlwPwNTkqaUTG4r4MSwPKAetKFWEzc-AFK43V-g5Z7WbXYLAsTahi2aksvLNECBfsEHGS-kHqsxmIvvc89oVDB0ZudS0KRfv3i1CxTmBCEri_mG-LIZu5-1fiavy5wNo1O-3_hvH_nWPt_gtf2zpo-JT4cz82jLfmaNVwIN5PodCdm7wrPDYxlaVeUwt1WEYc46ufubyxHAACzuj2hxY4P8hE22fsFCS4BYNv57CeKttRwSxhZJQ_Qt30o-l0UAlvO0_MNCwQBoTuKcMSbwPvfFxAV0S1e3UbBlcA8igvOowZXQi8l4Jz5o9U56SQGkO1ykY32lXBywY5xKkjfAaCky3-q_t71UjT10CGnaTaws1o_DCOLyRuXEXQOdHTav-WnggkzVlG6t5IgDmGTKvE94Pk7FOZmgqQztdrniXYcNuPt0EOKsvj06vPuRt88g9-Agw0crl6qp1vAWwYWOXQOroLVbhO4beilvPghfokl7vLUfgs0bgWHx1fhoGfFhOImCxlpHx8u6g4sFfUXYGOzpDRRvM3JfCvvnffyBkiE892NzhoEgnIeKo5TxRrhW98KGx1vf2-nNS999kODpHiufoIBHOSFs4CMTHLEFPQnObkv7_q2teTCJO7o4p3TX3M33ye7iuo6S2YsAcvHktY1IP_cxCAxjlfSM0/ba5vauz_AAKzRvK0I4oILjQU0asouptI/17) So the school quietly closed the investigation without an apology--and __released a statement claiming they had never accused or investigated her at all. __

A few days later, the school unveiled a "Revised Spirit Rock Speech Code" that only allowed "positive school spirit" and messages that "uphold the inclusive values of our school community."

**It explicitly bans students from expressing religious or political messages on the spirit rock --and allows the school officials to subjectively decide which messages are "positive." **

The Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education, which targeted and unlawfully investigated Gabby, violated her First, Fourth, Fifth, and Fourteenth Amendment rights.

**These school officials cannot be allowed to get away with harassing and accusing a high schooler who did nothing wrong --just because they disagree with her views. **

Alliance Defending Freedom is suing the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education to make sure it will answer for its blatantly unconstitutional actions--punishing students for their views. Law enforcement has been contacted and we are cooperating with the investigation." And now, imagine that message was aimed at YOU--because you got permission to paint your school's "spirit rock" with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk and the legacy he left to Christian youth. School officials never obtained permission from her parents to go through her phone, nor did they inform her or her parents of her constitutional right to remain silent and contact an attorney during a criminal investigation. The school punished Gabby--tried to silence her voice--yet officials had no problem supporting other student causes, including Black Lives Matter and protests against immigration enforcement. The hypocrisy couldn't be clearer. Of course, So the school quietly closed the investigation without an apology--and released a statement claiming they had never accused or investigated her at all. Today should be the 53rd anniversary of Roe v. Wade.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123822880/596678402/-1653156918?refcode=EM_F_260122Roe_N_SB_90DO_4_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzA5N2ZiZS1iMWY3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8STAjBps00PDRRVwv122bcLMsUGnz2nD0pAyVdhTv6M=) Peter,

Today should mark the 53rd anniversary of _Roe v. Wade._ However, this 1973 landmark decision, which protected abortion access for Americans nationwide, was overturned in 2022. Since then, GOP politicians have worked tirelessly to restrict our rights.

Last year, Republicans in Ohio tried to undermine the will of voters by pushing new legislation to restrict abortion access, despite Ohioans showing up to enshrine their freedoms in the state constitution the year prior. They made clear attempts to try to test the legal limits of the amendment in continued efforts to chip away at the reproductive freedoms that Ohioans overwhelmingly voted to protect.

Trump, with the blessing of Republicans in Congress, has taken major steps to attack abortion access, including by stripping away Medicaid funding for clinics, preventing veterans on VA health insurance from having abortions – with no exceptions, weakening data privacy rules protecting abortion patients, and more.

**We must stay vigilant. With the Republican trifecta in Washington, all reproductive care, from abortion to birth control, is under threat. It’s critical that we work together to protect our rights.**

name: Costello for U.S. Senate
subject: Help us reach 2,000 signatures by March 16
body:
Sharing posts and collecting signatures are two easy ways to help right now.

| | | | | [|
---](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=e162aa51d8&e=5d7176e969)
| | | | | |
Friends,
Two things: 1) check out and share David’s recent Trump Admin social media posts below; and 2) just a reminder that we’ve begun collecting signatures to place David’s name on Maine’s Democratic primary ballot and we’re seeking your help. The signature collection process is straightforward. Any individual in Maine can collect signatures and any**registered Democrat** in Maine can sign a petition. If you’re interested in helping, we’ll provide you with blank 8.5-inch by 14-inch petition form(s) and information on where (almost anywhere) and how to collect signatures. Signing the petition in no way commits the signer to supporting or voting for David. It simply allows us to petition the State to have David’s name added to Maine’s June ballot.
We need to collect 2,000 signatures by March 16 to qualify. There are any number of ways and places or events to utilize to collect signatures (e.g., resistance protests, DEM committee meetings, and the Maine Democrat’s Feb. 28 and March 1 town caucuses for instance). By way of example, David’s grandmother collected more than 200 signatures (in 2001) by simply keeping a petition form in her purse and asking friends to sign the petition as she went about her daily activities. If you are interested in helping, please let us know by emailing us at campaign@costelloforsenate.com.
Thank you and best,Team Costello
**A Few of David’s Recent Trump Admin Related Social Media Posts**
**Greenland and Beyond** If they weren’t so potentially damaging to our reputation, and physical and economic security, President Trump’s comments and actions regarding Canada, Greenland, and Latin America would be considered laughable. These senseless diplomatic, military, and economic threats only benefit global bad actors, like Putin and Russia. We should be strengthening, not weakening our military and economic alliances and relationships around the world, especially with the world’s democracies in the Americas, Europe (EU/NATO), and Asia (India, Japan, S. Korea, and the Philippines). The President’s chaotic approach to world affairs is looking more like “America Alone,” than “America First” or “America the Great,” again ... Senator Susan Collins, and her GOP colleagues, need to muster more backbone to mitigate such nonsensical and dangerous comments and behavior.
**Immigration and ICE** Senator Susan Collins and her GOP colleagues need to do more, a lot more, to reign-in the Trump administration’s unjust and counterproductive anti-immigration practices. No one is opposed to arresting criminals, whether they’re immigrants to the United States or natural born citizens, and virtually all Americans oppose illegal immigration. Also, most Americans, realize that legal immigration is good for our economy and country and have supported comprehensive immigration reform (including more resources to better secure our borders) for decades. What most American’s don’t support are the secret police-state style tactics being utilized by the Trump Administration to scare and round-up immigrants (legal and otherwise) and to demonize them and any Americans protesting the use of such unnecessary and un-American tactics.
Dealing with illegal immigration appropriately, like many other world-at-large challenges, is complicated and will require both national and multi-national solutions. Instead of overstating the negative impact of immigration and immigrants to distract attention, score political points, and accrue more power - the Trump Administration and GOP Congress should focus on comprehensive immigration reforms (like the bipartisan Gang of Eight styled reforms of 2013); including increasing, not decreasing, support for international efforts to stabilize countries in crisis so that residents aren’t compelled to leave.
**Trump’s Reckless Imperialism** Senior presidential aide Stephen Miller and President Trump are wrong. There is no justification for American imperialism (i.e., the extension of America’s power and influence in the world through coercion or force), nor imperialism exercised by any other nation. The world’s colonial powers realized this more than half a century ago. US Government actions that run counter to American and international law and ideals, including the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, will only weaken our nation’s long-term economic and physical security. It’s absurd and dangerous to think the United States, or any country, Russia and China included, has the right to forcefully take over any other territory or country (including Greenland, Taiwan, or Ukraine).
Senator Susan Collins and her colleagues need to reign in the mis-guided imperial aims of the Trump Administration before they further damage our country’s standing in the world. If the Administration truly wants to bolster our long-term economic and physical security it should strengthen, not continue to weaken, America’s foreign policy and foreign aid agencies. Boost our international competitiveness by increasing, not decreasing, investment in transportation, energy, and communications infrastructure, and scientific research and development. Negotiate smart, fair, and comprehensive trade agreements that include a global minimum corporate tax and enhanced labor and environmental protections, not rely on shortsighted, debilitating trade tariffs. And prioritize the enactment of far-reaching international nuclear and conventional arms control agreements. Only by becoming more fully, intelligently, and responsibly engaged in world affairs, not less so, is the USA likely to become more secure and prosperous.

body:
Holding this administration accountable is a must

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?&t=1&akid=2018%2E49239%2Esuu1v7)

Null,

Yesterday, I joined over 100 of my colleagues in the House of Representatives in co-sponsoring articles of impeachment against Department of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem.
**I want you to know this is not an action I take lightly, nor is it a piece of political theater.
**
It is a _last resort_ after Secretary Noem ignored my repeated calls to open investigations into the killing of Renee Nicole Good in Minneapolis and the death of Nenko Gantchev, a detainee at the North Lake Processing Center in Baldwin, Michigan.
Since she has given no indication of resigning for her repeated failures and abuses of power, **I am left with no choice but to join my colleagues in calling for her impeachment and prompt removal from office.**
Over the past year, Secretary Noem’s leadership has been reckless, chaotic, and corrupt. In her rush to meet Donald Trump's mass deportation quotas, she has deployed ICE within our communities without consulting local officials, resulting in fear, confusion, unnecessary violence, and several deaths.
**Secretary Noem is not merely failing to do her job as head of the Department of Homeland Security; under her purview, our country is _less safe_ , and it’s time for some real accountability.**
Of course, I'm clearheaded about the fact that Republicans are currently in control of the House and Senate and extremely unlikely to cross party lines to vote yes on Kristi Noem's impeachment. I know we're fighting an uphill battle here, but it's one we _must_ keep fighting.
**That's why I'm putting everything I have into winning this Senate race.** Because if we can keep Michigan blue and take back the Senate majority for Democrats, we will have a real chance at standing up to Trump and corrupt Cabinet members like Kristi Noem.
In tough moments like this, I refuse to get discouraged. Instead, I'm more motivated than ever – because I know that together, we can and will create the change our state and our country so desperately need.
In this for you, Michigan. More soon,

Haley
|
* * *

Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. | | Charlie Kirk built a movement for truth -- but his final message pointed to something eternal.

It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war.

His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before...

**It was about the Sabbath. **

name: Christina Hines
subject: 49 years of rights—gone.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Christina for Congress

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q1?refcode=x_260122_RoeVWadeAnniversary_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q1?refcode=x_260122_RoeVWadeAnniversary_act]
Dear friend, it’s Democrat Christina Hines—mom, prosecutor, and the woman running for Congress in MI-10!
Because of Trump and the Republicans who cater to him, my daughter has fewer rights over her body than her grandmother did. Her access to healthcare is getting worse, not better.
Women’s reproductive freedom lasted for 49 years here in the United States.
In 1973 , the Supreme Court prohibited states from banning abortions with Roe v. Wade .
In 2022 , the conservative majority on the Supreme Court overturned Roe —so I helped collect signatures for Michigan’s Proposal 3 to demand reproductive freedom in Michigan.
Now , 20 states have effectively banned or seriously restricted abortion, and more bans are on the ballot in 2026.
Overturning Roe was just the beginning . In his first year back in office, Donald Trump and the GOP banned abortion care for veterans at VA hospitals and tried to defund Planned Parenthood. Now, women’s healthcare is more in jeopardy than ever.
We need to take back control of the U.S. House, and to do that, we MUST win this district. Can you chip in $49 today? Each contribution helps us reach voters directly, break through the noise, and mobilize our neighbors. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q1?refcode=x_260122_RoeVWadeAnniversary_act&amount=49]
DONATE $49 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q1?refcode=x_260122_RoeVWadeAnniversary_act&amount=49]
Reproductive freedom is personal to me. I am a former sexual assault prosecutor, and I’ve advocated for hundreds of survivors. I’ve seen what happens when victims cannot access the help they need. I’ve also stood alongside close friends facing infertility and dangerous pregnancies, heart-wrenching situations where timely medical care was necessary to save their lives. In other states, those same women would have been forced to travel out of state just to survive. These decisions are never easy, and they are often made amid fear, grief, and prayer.
They keep taking away our freedoms. In the House, we can stop them.
Family and women’s healthcare is on the ballot in 2026. Donate $49 now to stop the government’s overreach and protect—and win back—reproductive rights for every American. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q1?refcode=x_260122_RoeVWadeAnniversary_act&amount=49]
DONATE $49 TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cbh_email-26q1?refcode=x_260122_RoeVWadeAnniversary_act&amount=49]
Love,
Christina

I’ve heard a lot of questions throughout the campaign

Derek, Since we kicked off this reelection campaign two weeks ago, I’ve heard from so many Pennsylvanians from all across our Commonwealth. I’ve heard your stories, your concerns, and your kind words. But I’ve also heard a lot of questions — so I wanted to use this email to address some FAQs about our campaign. **_What is the state of the race right now?_** Just like every other statewide election in Pennsylvania, it’s shaping up to be a close one. We’re running in the swingiest of swing states — which means every TV ad, every campaign event, and yes, every dollar, could be the tipping point. **_What can I do to help?_** The most effective way you can boost our campaign right now is by making an early investment. I know Election Day is still months away... but take it from me: Even a $1 or $10 donation in January goes a whole lot further than a $100 donation the day before the election. [_**So if you’re able, I’d really appreciate it if you could click here and make a grassroots donation of any size.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123826458/596690855/1156619579?refcode=email_012226_FAQs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZTlhNzEwZi1iNmY3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q1RxHWfjFm-r45_5QCYClK_BhcrgpKfoc2EJieIiJRc=) **_What’s the biggest challenge for the campaign?_** Here’s the thing: When Pennsylvanians hear about everything we’ve accomplished together — cutting taxes, investing in public education, defending our fundamental freedoms, standing up to the President — we earn their support. Pete Hegseth decided he's going to censure me, and is threatening to demote me and reduce my pension.

I got shot at in service to this country. I missed holidays and birthdays. I commanded a space shuttle mission and launched to the International Space Station while my wife recovered from a gunshot wound to the head.

My rank and retirement are things that I earned through my service and sacrifice for this country. Generations of servicemembers have done the same. Pete Hegseth wants to send a message to every single one that he will come after them if they say something he doesn’t like.

You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.

**Pete Hegseth can threaten to reduce my rank and my pension. But I am not going to let him intimidate me, or anyone else. He is not going to stop me from defending our democracy from a president who is hellbent on destroying it.**

If they think this is going to shut me up, they’ve got another thing coming.

Dear Friends,
Housing costs are squeezing families across Northern California! That’s why I’m inviting you to join me for a FREE Housing Town Hall [NorCalHousingTownHall.eventbrite.com] on Thursday, January 29 in Oakland where I’ll share my plan to increase housing across California and make sure it’s affordable and accessible for the people who live and work here.
I’m running for Governor to lower the cost of living, address homelessness with real solutions, and invest in our communities. Most importantly, I want to hear directly from you about what you’re seeing in the community!
I’m honored to be joined by special guest speakers:
* Barbara Lee , Mayor of Oakland

Peter,
Missouri lawmakers and officials are going to extreme lengths to silence their own constituents:

* When Missouri voters fought back, collecting 300,000 signatures to put the gerrymandered map to a vote in a referendum, officials rejected a full one-third of them.

But anti-democracy forces are not going to back down in Missouri, or anywhere else they think they can silence voters.

I'm emailing you directly because I believe it is critical for every American to understand the true impact of Donald Trump's "leadership."
Peter,

Yesterday, President Trump spoke in Davos at the World Economic Forum. His speech was dangerous, disrespectful, and frankly unhinged. I'm emailing you directly because I believe it is critical for every American to understand the true impact of Donald Trump's recklessness.

For over an hour, Donald Trump rambled on to our European and Canadian allies, doing everything in his power to diminish these critical relationships that have been intact since before I was even born. He thinks he's making America look strong and powerful — but in truth, he's doing the exact opposite. And the American people are left to deal with this fallout directly.

Our key allies are shying away from purchasing American goods, harming our economies back at home. They are visibly angry and frustrated with the Trump administration, and looking to other allies for support, leaving our small businesses and our people in the dust. Americans are struggling to afford basic necessities, are being stripped of their healthcare, and are feeling left behind by their government. Meanwhile, our president is too busy to care — instead putting all his focus into claiming Greenland for himself. **Instead of proving America is a leader in the free world, Trump is acting like a bully on a playground, and he should be embarrassed by his actions.**

But, this isn't new for Donald Trump. Petty politics and personal vendettas have defined his presidency. His speech yesterday proves just how out of touch he is, both with our allies and with the very people he was elected to represent. It's time for change.

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Peter,

Congress is about to vote on even more funding for ICE.

Despite the horrors Trump’s secret police are unleashing on our
communities, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries won’t whip Democratic
votes to stop it.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260122.LlqXu1&refcode=em20260122-37393&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37393%2E1203867%2EsowF1_ ]The American Prospect: Jeffries won’t whip vote against ICE funding.
While the House Democratic leader announced personal opposition to a
funding bill for the Department of Homeland Security, he won’t pressure
his colleagues to do the same.

This is cowardice in the face of fascism.

ICE is shooting and killing people, arresting and abducting children off
the streets, violently ripping people from their homes & vehicles and
detaining them for hours or days on end, and operating under an
unconstitutional memo that gives them the power to forcibly enter people’s

After I reminded our servicemembers of their obligations to uphold their oaths to the Constitution, Donald Trump called for me to be arrested, tried for treason, and executed.

Then the President and his MAGA lackeys launched a bogus FBI inquiry into me and other veteran Members of Congress who dared to speak out against this corrupt administration.

**Now, Trump is sending his political cronies at the Justice Department, including former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, to try and threaten and intimidate me.**

I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. I took an oath to defend the Constitution as a paratrooper, Army Ranger, and now Member of Congress. It’s a lifetime oath, and I intend to keep it.

Donald Trump has picked a fight with the wrong people. I refuse to be intimidated, and I won’t stand for our democracy to be dismantled. None of us want to live in an America where the President can weaponize the government against their perceived enemies.

While the GOP fights to restrict more and more of our rights, I will spend every day in Congress fighting to win back and codify reproductive freedom for every American.

My name is **Mark "Oz" Geist**. I'm a Marine Corps veteran, one of the Benghazi "secret soldiers," and a Colorado native who has spent my life around men tested under real pressure -- not political pressure, but the kind that reveals who you are when everything is on the line._I know what leadership looks like when it 's forged in adversity._ That's why today I want to tell you about a friend of mine -- a very rare man -- one I'm proud to call a brother. _[**Victor Marx is running for Governor of Colorado,****and I believe he is exactly the kind of leader this moment demands.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zba3nebdie23tld4si5use5uia7283hsmuefi9d8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shh6cpr6c5h2bs)_

---
Victor is a fellow Marine Corps veteran, a devoted husband and father, a man of deep faith, and someone who has spent decades putting his own life on the line to rescue the vulnerable and stand up where others look away. His life wasn't shaped in boardrooms or political backrooms -- _it was shaped through hardship, service, and a commitment to protect others at any cost._**Above all, Victor Marx is a testament to what God can do with a life surrendered to Him.** **I endorsed Victor from Day One in this race** and was honored to stand with him at his announcement rally in Colorado Springs _[**_(which you can watch here)_**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z573cnrc3e5578m93v3vup21gldjg33vno77cdho_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shh6cpr6c5h2bs)._ I did that because I recognize integrity when I see it -- and because Colorado is at a crossroads. Today, I'm asking you to join me in supporting Victor, because we need _way _fewer politicians and more men like him in service to the people._**[Will you join me and help back Victor's campaign with your grassroots contribution of $15, $25, $40, or even $100 or more today?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfm3smuh3iehovlmfl7r8sevb1v8mo8vsvr8naqo_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shh6cpr6c5h2bs)**_

He's not running to manage decline -- **he 's running to restore fairness, accountability, and leadership that actually serves the people.** I believe Victor has the integrity and the ability to change what needs to be changed -- not just for ourselves, but for all Coloradans -- so our children and future generations inherit something better than what we have right now.**We have to do this now -- and Victor Marx is the man for the job.** If you believe we deserve tested leadership with the courage to act, I hope you'll join me in standing with Victor and support his campaign today. **[Whether you can send $100 or $15, Victor needs your grassroots support to help put the Democrats and the political establishment on notice and win this fight. ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjjhjp4l6gln2ur92sgitrn6rih4uihhngiq2ln0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shh6cpr6c5h2bs)**

ChongLy Thao is a US citizen and a St. Paul resident. His story captures the entire essence of ICE’s brutal and callous operations in our state. Here’s the full account from a family member:
* “ICE came to my brother-in-law Saly's apartment, broke down the door, trashed the place, handcuffed him, and put a gun to his daughter-in-law's head. They did not allow him to put on proper clothing and forced him outside in freezing weather.

* Saly is a naturalized U.S. citizen. He has NO criminal record.

* ICE drove him around for nearly an hour, questioned him, and fingerprinted him. Only after all of that did they realize he had no criminal history and no reason to be detained. They then dropped him back off at his apartment like nothing happened.

* We believe they were looking for someone who previously lived there, but instead of asking for identification, they chose violence, intimidation, and humiliation.”

Friend, situations like this reinforce what we already know. ICE is not only cruel, aggressive, and brutal. They are also extremely incompetent and careless.
The very idea of treating any elderly person like this is unacceptable, citizen or not. To force a man at gunpoint into the freezing cold, not even allowing him to put on clothes, let alone prove his citizenship, then unlawfully detaining him to only realize he’s not the person you’re looking for; it’s a disgusting combination of evil and stupid.
Stories like this one prove the real goal of Trump’s ICE crackdown: To punish the citizens of a state that didn’t vote for him. To humiliate regular Americans and trample on their civil rights as an intimidation tactic. We have to keep fighting back.

Fellow Patriot,

What happened **_this past Sunday_** in St. Paul should stop every church-going American cold.

**_A mob forced its way into a church during a Sunday worship service_** — during prayer — intimidating families, elderly parishioners, and children while shouting political slogans. This was not peaceful protest. It was an invasion of a sanctuary.

In a recent letter to its members nationwide, CatholicVote said it plainly: disrupting a church service is not protest — it is a crime. They are right. And it should alarm anyone who believes the First Amendment still matters.

The very first freedom protected in our Constitution is the free exercise of religion. Our Founders placed it first for a reason.

**_When people storm a sanctuary to intimidate worshippers, they are violating civil rights and crossing a line our nation was founded to defend._**

As a former Sheriff, I know the difference between lawful protest and lawlessness. As a candidate for Congress, I also know this: when leaders refuse to enforce the law, these attacks spread. Silence from those in power becomes permission for the next one.

**If a church can be invaded during prayer in Minnesota today, it can happen anywhere tomorrow.**

Our nation was founded on the belief that Americans could worship freely, without fear or intimidation. Protecting that freedom is not optional. It is a constitutional duty.

[**If you believe churches should remain protected ground, if you believe the First Amendment still means what it says, I ask you to stand with me today.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3df7355393c248a0bc92a9e52653a885&_e=NAYMuO49AwTrT5vaasXbNIR-IBQo1ANa6Kt-3HX7q7Oc9uEur4s4Ha99JPF-vS46lCH_mVdaBJn_CytgOXsSqHD9fh6pCvR7acLkgFR403v4Zu4cu0KlHdVgxvd3gWTkzdezrnBglsknGJo-28pF36KA70nL2HRGwgNbxg-7gLgeQfhui0u7KH7RYcs9sxLUCGpbZuCGvQKs0AHgNSc_Jm5eqTooEwGPtirUxVCEcyyWMGfmjud1Yg63VhVHb0vOvjNr76Vu1M5QKjJmAzHim5WV_w7_rUXwV5brkTqvJOAb8-O7eXu82I5rXEjazBJhMV-LKhOkBWzVR5vMiBN8OM3c8z7kVZst8bFYPYcB_M7z2_aJdJh1_seB2VfH2mib8EWy6_hqTAuEzQAD7ih9zwsFFsIiqau2u_Gp2rErq8OL6dx0lalIydnAqvV_lfS-w3M9m32eAmhv6RBJ9yVzJoyP004A3IR-iGWf8JAWI5Hm7veX8KmdQXLz2-OixKrBtwT_L5SemTKpdinTaPLZNvxsZJLbPjuoXIsGEcPgMDlngJhEH9cD2Q7obJ5PVm-kXBiFeoIqYgduxMmbfHFaW3p3uusVfsd6SvfhQHOcQJCz_zBV7gipk-GehISG1eXoWVQVPtN1sYO1_WLo0aSPTzZUAp6AtoLzS6ADVHF_lJA%3D)

clean_body: | Fellow Patriot, What happened this past Sunday in St. Paul should stop every church-going American cold. A mob forced its way into a church during a Sunday worship service — during prayer — intimidating families, elderly parishioners, and children while shouting political slogans. This was not peaceful protest. It was an invasion of a sanctuary. In a recent letter to its members nationwide, CatholicVote said it plainly: disrupting a church service is not protest — it is a crime. They are right. And it should alarm anyone who believes the First Amendment still matters. The very first freedom protected in our Constitution is the free exercise of religion. Our Founders placed it first for a reason. When people storm a sanctuary to intimidate worshippers, they are violating civil rights and crossing a line our nation was founded to defend. As a former Sheriff, I know the difference between lawful protest and lawlessness. As a candidate for Congress, I also know this: when leaders refuse to enforce the law, these attacks spread. Silence from those in power becomes permission for the next one. If a church can be invaded during prayer in Minnesota today, it can happen anywhere tomorrow. Our nation was founded on the belief that Americans could worship freely, without fear or intimidation. Protecting that freedom is not optional. It is a constitutional duty. Respectfully, Mark Lamb Sheriff, Pinal County, Arizona (Ret.) | | Today marks the 53rd anniversary of the historic Supreme Court decision in _Roe v. Wade._ In 1973, the Supreme Court established the legal right to abortion. This decision marked a crucial moment in the fight for reproductive rights, recognizing autonomy over our own bodies and safeguarding the right to make family planning decisions. For decades, _Roe v. Wade_ has been a symbol of progress and a cornerstone of reproductive freedom. However, the _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health_ decision in 2022 has posed a significant challenge to the principles established by _Roe v. Wade_. This decision allows states to impose restrictive abortion laws and undermines the foundation of reproductive rights. This catastrophic decision jeopardizes access to safe and legal abortion services. Since then, in communities across the country, citizens have been living with the devastating and deadly consequences of this ruling. In the years since the _Dobbs_ decision, there has been an escalation in attacks on reproductive freedom, including a forced vote in the House by the radical right-wing majority attempting to limit abortion care. Despite these attacks, Washington is committed to ensuring safe, reliable access to sexual and reproductive healthcare. **Washington continues to protect access to lifesaving health care, including abortions.** I want today's anniversary to serve as a reminder to stay true to our commitments to reproductive freedom. My commitment to you is that I will remain a steadfast advocate for reproductive freedom in Northwest Washington and in the halls of Congress. **I will protect your ability to make decisions about your body — and to keep the politicians, judges, and radical extremists out of it.** Abortions are deeply personal medical decisions that should be between someone who is pregnant and their doctor. Abortion is health care, and people have the right to make their own decisions without government interference. This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree. As long as I have the privilege of serving the people of Northwest Washington in Congress, I will stand for the right to safe and legal abortions. clean_body: This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree. | | | | Today marks the 53rd anniversary of the historic Supreme Court decision in Roe v. Wade. In 1973, the Supreme Court established the legal right to abortion. This decision marked a crucial moment in the fight for reproductive rights, recognizing autonomy over our own bodies and safeguarding the right to make family planning decisions. For decades, Roe v. Wade has been a symbol of progress and a cornerstone of reproductive freedom. However, the Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health decision in 2022 has posed a significant challenge to the principles established by Roe v. Wade. This decision allows states to impose restrictive abortion laws and undermines the foundation of reproductive rights. This catastrophic decision jeopardizes access to safe and legal abortion services. Since then, in communities across the country, citizens have been living with the devastating and deadly consequences of this ruling. In the years since the Dobbs decision, there has been an escalation in attacks on reproductive freedom, including a forced vote in the House by the radical right-wing majority attempting to limit abortion care. Despite these attacks, Washington is committed to ensuring safe, reliable access to sexual and reproductive healthcare. Washington continues to protect access to lifesaving health care, including abortions. I want today's anniversary to serve as a reminder to stay true to our commitments to reproductive freedom. My commitment to you is that I will remain a steadfast advocate for reproductive freedom in Northwest Washington and in the halls of Congress. I will protect your ability to make decisions about your body — and to keep the politicians, judges, and radical extremists out of it. Abortions are deeply personal medical decisions that should be between someone who is pregnant and their doctor. Abortion is health care, and people have the right to make their own decisions without government interference. This should not be political whatsoever, and a strong majority of the American people agree. As long as I have the privilege of serving the people of Northwest Washington in Congress, I will stand for the right to safe and legal abortions. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: What should have been.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Today would have been the 53rd anniversary of Roe v. Wade — January 22, 1973. It’s a date I learned about all through school. In the 90s, it was taught as a long-settled judicial decision that had been integral in the fight for true equality for women.
Today’s students are learning a very different lesson in their U.S. history classes.
Instead of marking 50+ years of progress today, we’ve regressed to a painful debate and a dangerous reality for the people whose bodily autonomy has been stripped away.
It’s sadly predictable that on this day of all days, we’re once again debating anti-choice bills on the House floor brought by MAGA Republicans — bills designed to make pregnancy more dangerous, more expensive, and more terrifying for millions.
People are dying as a direct result of abortion bans. Women have been denied care while hemorrhaging. Doctors have been forced to wait until patients are on the brink of death to deliver care. Pregnant people have fled their states to get medical care before it’s too late for their bodies, their fertility, and their future. Maternal and infant mortality are on the rise, and whole families have been devastated by losses that never should have happened.
Meanwhile, Republican politicians have made it clear: This is exactly what they wanted.
Where’s the outrage from the so-called “pro-life” party?
Today’s GOP slashes food assistance and blocks paid family leave. They gut health care and oppose universal child care, all while prices keep rising.
They prop up fake clinics called “crisis pregnancy centers” that prey on vulnerable people with misinformation and shame.
They cruelly pressure women to carry pregnancies they don’t want and can’t safely continue.
The decision to continue a pregnancy and to raise a child is serious, private, and deeply personal. And health risks aside, the long-term consequences of being denied that choice are real:
* Women denied an abortion are four times more likely to live below the federal poverty line.
* They’re more likely to be evicted, go bankrupt, and shoulder crushing debt.
* They’re more likely to stay in abusive relationships.
* And their children are more likely to struggle financially and developmentally, too.
None of that is pro-life.
While we’re grieving this reality we find ourselves in, I don’t want today to only be about grief. I want it to be about resolve, too. Here are five ways we can keep fighting:
1. Vote in the midterms this year. Roe fell as a consequence of elections. Trump packed the Supreme Court with extremists in his first term, and every day in Congress, MAGA Republicans continue to try to chip away at our rights.
2. Support state and local candidates who are fighting abortion bans in their states.
3. Donate directly to abortion funds . Visit the National Network of Abortion Funds [https://abortionfunds.org/find-a-fund/] to find your local fund.
4. Call your representatives (state and federal!) and make sure they’re supporting all the ways we can protect people from these bans.
5. Talk to your friends and family about why this matters so much. Your voice has the power to educate, persuade, and motivate the people in your life, more than you may know.
Roe recognized a simple truth: that people deserve control over their own bodies and futures. Roe’s fall was and still is devastating. But this is not our grandparents’ fight.
We have stronger networks, better tools, proven strategies, and we have the American majority behind us. The fact is that most Americans want abortion to be legal . Most believe that these decisions belong to patients and their doctors, not politicians.
Today, let’s commit to keep fighting until every person in this country has the freedom to decide what happens in their own body. Abortion rights are a kitchen table issue, an economic issue, a life and death issue. And an issue that can win elections.
With determination,
Sara

name: Team AOC
subject: Prepare for Winter Storm Fern
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
This weekend, a serious winter storm will impact over 180 million Americans — **or nearly half of the country’s population** — across 35 states in the South, Midwest, and Northeast.
This winter storm, also called _Fern_ by The Weather Channel, is expected to bring heavy snow, freezing rain, and extreme cold as early as tomorrow, with temperatures remaining well below normal for over a week.1
**Here are a few ways you can prepare for the cold conditions (and[you can find more useful tips at the Red Cross’s website here →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/35620?t=1&akid=10634%2E2526796%2EUSa7_u)):**
* Keep cell phones and external batteries charging while you have electricity.
* Leave the faucets in every sink of your home dripping slightly, day and night — from both the hot and cold taps — to prevent pipes bursting from the extreme cold.2
* Have plenty of dry blankets and clothing on hand. Wet, cold clothing increases chances of hypothermia.
* Reduce strain on the power grid by layering clothing to keep warm, rather than turning up the heat on your thermostat.
* Research if your state has emergency warming centers, and make a plan to get to them in case of an emergency.
* Avoid traveling during the storm, unless in an emergency situation.
* _If you must drive: use your hazard lights, drive slowly, and keep 3 times the normal following distance between the car ahead of you._

**In case of a long-term power outage and delayed emergency services:**
* Close doors within your home to conserve heat, and use towels under doors to insulate rooms.
* The Red Cross suggests having 3 days worth of the following on hand, stored in go-bags if you need to leave your home in an emergency:
* Bottled water – experts suggest having a gallon of water per person, per day, on hand.
* Food that doesn’t require refrigeration or cooking (dried fruit, nuts, canned fish or vegetables, granola bars, jerky, etc)
* Manual can opener
* Baby supplies
* Pet food
* First aid supplies ([here are suggestions from the Red Cross](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/35621?t=2&akid=10634%2E2526796%2EUSa7_u))
* Extra prescription medications
* Batteries
* Flashlights
* Tea candles (see below on fire safety)

**Carbon monoxide poisoning and fires increase during winter power outages due to people improperly heating their homes.** A few tips:
* Test — or install — battery-operated carbon monoxide and smoke detectors in your home, and make sure they are functioning properly.
* **Never run a generator (or car) inside an enclosed space.[Review generator safety tips here.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/35622?t=3&akid=10634%2E2526796%2EUSa7_u)**
* If you are using candles for light, keep them out of the reach of children and at least 3 feet away from flammable objects like curtains, beds, and sofas. Never leave a candle burning when you go to sleep.3

And most importantly: **check in with your nearby neighbors, friends, and family regularly.** Senior citizens and families with young children may need an extra hand in advance of, and during, the storm.
**This list is not comprehensive.[You can find more useful tips on winter storm preparedness at the Red Cross’s website here →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/35620?t=4&akid=10634%2E2526796%2EUSa7_u)**
We will be in touch as the storm progresses.
Stay safe, and keep warm,
Team AOC

3: [**National Weather Service:** Home fires](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/35625?t=7&akid=10634%2E2526796%2EUSa7_u)

# Trump aims to secures total access to Greenland in new deal
President Donald Trump announced Thursday that the US is actively negotiating **["total access" to Greenland](https://substack.com/redirect/4688e290-f694-4741-8932-30a3cea5dbd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with no end date or cost, following a framework deal with NATO after talks with Secretary General Mark Rutte, as he told Fox Business' Maria Bartiromo in Davos. The move aims to bolster Arctic security against Russia and China while scrapping planned European tariffs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4688e290-f694-4741-8932-30a3cea5dbd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strategic security priority** : Greenland's location makes it vital for monitoring threats, with Trump stating everything incoming "comes over Greenland" if adversaries attack.
* **No-cost deal details** : Negotiations focus on indefinite US military and total access rights without any payment from the United States.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/342e5622-c323-44b6-bc36-3e246bd9341d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **NATO framework agreement** : A productive meeting with Mark Rutte produced a future deal outline covering Greenland and the broader Arctic region for allied benefit.
* **Tariff threat withdrawn** : Trump halted February 1 tariffs on European nations backing Greenland, calling the emerging deal great for the US and all NATO members.
