# Markets roar back as Trump drops Europe tariffs
U.S. **[stocks surged sharply Wednesday](https://substack.com/redirect/195c0caa-c6ef-453a-9765-d7e85ae1d598?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after President Trump announced a deal framework with NATO on Greenland, scrapping planned tariffs on European allies that had triggered a steep sell-off the prior day. The Dow jumped nearly 600 points, the S&P 500 rose 1.16% and the Nasdaq gained 1.18%, easing trade-war fears.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/195c0caa-c6ef-453a-9765-d7e85ae1d598?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Small Caps Soar Higher** : Russell 2000 hit all-time high, up 1% and outperforming S&P 500 for 13th straight day in 2026 amid rate-cut hopes and strong U.S. sentiment.
* **Tech Rebound Leads Gains** : Nvidia and AMD rallied as growth stocks recovered; Broadcom rose on "insatiable" AI chip demand with analysts raising targets.
* **Bank Stocks Climb on Policy** : Citigroup and Capital One advanced despite Trump's proposal for 10% credit card rate cap, as legislative hurdles remain uncertain.
* **Netflix Plunges on Guidance** : Shares dropped 4% despite Q4 earnings beat, as weak Q1 outlook missed expectations and fueled concerns over subscriber growth.

# Bezos unleashes "TeraWave" to challenge Starlink's dominance
Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin unveiled TeraWave on Wednesday, a massive satellite network of **[5,408 spacecraft set to challenge SpaceX's Starlink](https://substack.com/redirect/dde3e85e-22cf-498c-ab1e-5592ee443252?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and even Amazon's own Leo service by delivering ultra-high-speed connectivity up to 6 terabits per second to enterprises, governments, and data centers starting deployments in late 2027.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dde3e85e-22cf-498c-ab1e-5592ee443252?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive constellation planned:** Blue Origin aims to deploy 5,408 satellites across low and medium Earth orbits for global coverage focused on high-bandwidth enterprise and government needs.
* **Blazing data speeds promised:** TeraWave targets up to 6 terabits per second throughput using advanced optical communications, far exceeding typical consumer satellite internet capabilities.
* **Targeted customer focus:** The network will serve roughly 100,000 high-value clients like data centers and governments rather than mass residential users targeted by Starlink.
* **Bezos doubles down on space:** This marks Blue Origin's bold entry into satellite communications, building on New Glenn rocket successes and Bezos' vision of it surpassing Amazon in scale.

# Trump demands Congress slam 10% credit card rate cap
President Donald Trump **[urged Congress from Davos](https://substack.com/redirect/622dade8-4895-43d7-b0ed-1f3960e42827?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to pass legislation capping credit card interest rates at 10% for one year, arguing it would help millions of Americans save for homes amid complaints of usurious 28-32% rates charged by banks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/622dade8-4895-43d7-b0ed-1f3960e42827?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump escalates push** : After initial voluntary calls to banks via social media, Trump shifted to demanding mandatory congressional action during his World Economic Forum speech.
* **Banking industry revolts** : Leaders like JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon labeled the cap an "economic disaster" that could slash credit access for 80% of Americans and urged testing it in select states first.
* **Bipartisan bill stalled** : Similar 10% cap proposals, including one from Sen. Josh Hawley and Sen. Bernie Sanders for five years, have previously failed to advance in Congress.
* **Stocks surge on skepticism** : Bank shares rose sharply as analysts cited low odds of passage due to Republican leadership opposition and potential revenue losses in the billions.

# **Bitcoin teeters near 88K amid rally caution**
Bitcoin **[hovers near $88,000](https://substack.com/redirect/3830b54c-6c79-4d8e-9af6-863001ad30e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after briefly hitting $90,000 Wednesday as President Trump backs crypto legislation, but Wall Street analysts warn against chasing rallies following an 8% pullback from recent highs near $98,000.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3830b54c-6c79-4d8e-9af6-863001ad30e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Analysts Urge Caution** : Compass Point's Ed Engel cautions against chasing rallies until Bitcoin reclaims short-term holders' average cost basis at $98,000; Fundstrat's Sean Farrell notes large flows failing to sustain momentum as a bearish sign.
* **Critical Support Levels** : A sustained break below $87,000 would invalidate bullish views and trigger a painful retracement, per 10X Research, which still sees the pullback as a buying opportunity with long-side bias.
* **Legislative Optimism Fades** : Trump's encouragement on crypto market structure bills boosted sentiment, but Polymarket odds of Congress passing regulation in 2026 dropped to 40% from 80%, amid Coinbase withdrawing support over amendments.
* **Market Mixed Signals** : Bitcoin erased much of its year-to-date gains after a negative Q4, with some viewing the dip as constructive while others highlight failed momentum despite major purchases like MicroStrategy's recent buys.

# Vanguard dumped Japan their bond bet before epic selloff
Vanguard Asset Management **[halted its aggressive buying](https://substack.com/redirect/6e2c6260-2d83-48d0-8157-f7f8ecfd8490?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of long-dated Japanese government bonds at the start of 2026, just before Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's snap election call and deep tax-cut proposals triggered a massive selloff that drove long-term JGB yields to record highs, up nearly 30 basis points.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e2c6260-2d83-48d0-8157-f7f8ecfd8490?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Timing Proves Prescient:** Vanguard's senior rates head Ales Koutny paused purchases early in the year, sidestepping the turmoil from fiscal policy shifts and election uncertainty.
* **Perfect Storm Hits JGBs:** Concerns over unfunded spending limits and potential consumption tax changes sparked weak auction demand and insurer sales, hammering long-dated bonds.
* **Yields Surge Dramatically:** Long-maturity JGB yields soared nearly 30 basis points to historic peaks before partially rebounding, with the 30-year yield dropping 14 basis points to 3.74% amid volatile trading.
* **Broader Market Caution:** Koutny highlighted fiscal constraints in Japan, where consumption tax funds over 20% of revenue, warning against unsustainable policy experiments in a high-debt environment.

Fellow Conservative,

When hardworking Minnesotans like you pay taxes to feed hungry children, the last thing we expect is for those funds to be used to buy luxury cars, overseas properties, and lavish lifestyles for scammers.

But that's precisely what happened right here in Minnesota with the Feeding Our Future scandal – over $250 million in federal child nutrition dollars stolen through fake claims, phony sites, and outright fraud.

As a retired Navy SEAL who's spent my life fighting for America and holding the line on accountability, I believe anyone who betrays our trust like this – especially if they're naturalized citizens – should face severe consequences, and illegal aliens need to be deported!

**If you don’t have time to finish this entire email, please do me a quick favor and answer the question below:**

_**Should we deport any naturalized citizen who steals from the American taxpayer?**_

clean_body: The first step in this journey has been accomplished: Tim Walz is out of the governor’s race. This happened on his watch, and he did absolutely nothing to stop it. | Fellow Conservative, When hardworking Minnesotans like you pay taxes to feed hungry children, the last thing we expect is for those funds to be used to buy luxury cars, overseas properties, and lavish lifestyles for scammers. But that's precisely what happened right here in Minnesota with the Feeding Our Future scandal – over $250 million in federal child nutrition dollars stolen through fake claims, phony sites, and outright fraud. As a retired Navy SEAL who's spent my life fighting for America and holding the line on accountability, I believe anyone who betrays our trust like this – especially if they're naturalized citizens – should face severe consequences, and illegal aliens need to be deported! If you don’t have time to finish this entire email, please do me a quick favor and answer the question below: Should we deport any naturalized citizen who steals from the American taxpayer? Prosecutors have already secured dozens of convictions, with assets including Porsches and millions of dollars in cash being seized. But we need stronger laws to ensure this never happens again and to send a clear message: Fraud against American taxpayers will not be tolerated. The first step in this journey has been accomplished: Tim Walz is out of the governor’s race. This happened on his watch, and he did absolutely nothing to stop it. Now, we need to turn our eyes to the open United States Senate seat, where I’m a Republican candidate. I support the introduction of bold new measures in Congress to crack down on these schemes. I need to hear from you – We've seen enough excuses and weak oversight. It's time for leadership that puts America – and Minnesotans – first. For love of country, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota Former Navy SEAL officer Marine Corps Veteran Proud Minnesotan FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. | Dear Fellow American,

This is a shocker. Pennsylvania officials reportedly admitted "for decades, the Department of Motor Vehicles had _allowed non-U.S. citizens to register to vote_ through the state's 'motor voter' system."
This breach of election integrity has now been compounded by the Third Circuit Court's recent decision to **deny** allies of Judicial Watch standing to sue for the associated voter information (the Public Interest Legal Foundation, or PILF).
This voter info is **guaranteed** under the National Voter Registration Act (NVRA).
Dirty Voter Rolls.
No Private Oversight.
A **dangerous** combination for faith and confidence in our elections.
**_That 's why your Judicial Watch has filed a brief to the Supreme Court of the United States_** (along with the Allied Educational Foundation, or AEF), asking the court to **_reverse the_** **decision** of the Third Court and grant PILF standing to sue.
_[I'm emailing you today to request that you join Judicial Watch as a donor with a tax-deductible gift to support this effort](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79093&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_, along with the rest of our nation-leading election integrity litigation.
| [ Support The Fight for Clean Voter Rolls ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79093&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)

You have helped expand our work by following our fights and sharing our content. Thank you.

But we cannot do this work without strong financial support from our donors.

**_WHY IT MATTERS FOR CLEAN ELECTIONS_**

Private individuals and organizations have lawful access to public records under the NVRA's public-disclosure provision. The Third Circuit Court is denying this access.

Such _barriers to access voter data mean less transparency_ and more opportunities for _dirty voter rolls to go undetected, impacting election integrity_.

_The outcome of this case could have a significant impact on Americans ' right to monitor the accuracy of voter rolls nationwide_.

**_WHY YOUR SUPPORT MATTERS_**

_[The support of our donors](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79093&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_ is all that allows **Judicial Watch** to lead these election integrity efforts and _[continuously expand our docket](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=79093&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_ , quickly responding when new cases emerge.

We have already removed over **5 million dirty names** from voter rolls. And this year we are litigating 140+ cases to fight for government accountability and combat the radical Left's efforts to steal our elections.

As the national leader in election integrity litigation, Judicial Watch also brings our 32 years of experience, winning reputation, and litigative muscle to bear in partnership with aligned organizations who are also doing important work.

Tom Fitton

subject: Stay warm this weekend, Texas! ❄️🧊🥶
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
BUNDLE UP:
Stay prepared as winter cold kicks in this weekend
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20arctic%20blast.jpg]
Another winter storm is on its way, so prepare accordingly! This incoming winter storm in Texas is further proof how climate change is causing more extreme fluctuations in our weather.
We shouldn't have to worry about the grid failing us AGAIN!
There's still weeks of winter left, and if you've lived in Texas for a while, you know how fast weather can change from one moment to the next. We all know Gov. Abbott's ERCOT has a shaky record at best (remember Winter Storm Uri?), so now's a good time to stock up on the essentials. Check out and share this winter weather preparedness guide. [https://www.texastribune.org/2026/01/21/texas-winter-storm-watch-how-to-prepare/]
https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1HPhrg6qes/ [https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1HPhrg6qes/]
Celebrating MLK's legacy and recommitting to his revolutionary vision
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2026%20MLK%20collage.jpg]
From Houston, to Dallas, to San Antonio, TOP staff and members came together with community allies to march Monday in observance of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day.
Honoring Dr. King’s life means acknowledging his full unapologetic self, not as some timid peacemaker who always “played by the rules” as today’s conservatives would have us believe, but as a revolutionary leader who organized communities, rallied the masses, challenged the status quo, drove change, and transformed society through his philosophy of nonviolence.
As our nation slides into authoritarianism under this administration, Dr. King’s teachings and vision have never been more needed. He knew full well that changing hearts and minds required more than simply building bonds with one another, but constructing whole bridges rooted in unshakeable solidarity. This is work TOP has proudly committed itself to for now over 15 years.
We also congratulate our very own Dr. Doshie Piper, TOP Restorative Justice Coordinator, for her tireless work as Chair of San Antonio’s Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Commission [https://www.sa.gov/Directory/Departments/CE/Special-Events/MLK/Commission] . The commission oversees the city’s annual MLK march — the LARGEST MLK march in the nation! [https://www.tpr.org/arts-culture/2026-01-19/in-san-antonio-the-nations-largest-mlk-march-takes-on-added-meaning]
KEEP UP THE PRESSURE: Call your U.S. Senator to extend ACA subsidies
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Healthcare%20is%20a%20human%20right.jpg]
THERE’S STILL TIME: After weeks of ramping up pressure, the U.S. House of Representatives on Jan.8th FINALLY passed a three-year extension of the enhanced premium tax credits for people buying insurance on HealthCare.gov [https://www.healthcare.gov/] , to make their healthcare more affordable. This was a people-powered win, but we can’t let our foot off the gas.
The bill is now in the U.S. Senate though, where it faces an uphill battle. Republican Senate leaders haven't committed to holding a vote on the bill. We need to build momentum.
https://secure.everyaction.com/vukGCLkSoki0nH7HupNBAg2 [https://secure.everyaction.com/vukGCLkSoki0nH7HupNBAg2]
CRITICAL IGNORING:
A skill to improve focus, protect mental health, and keep our eyes on the prize
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Critical%20Ignoring%20graphic.jpg]
WE have the ability to deliberately and strategically withhold our attention from trivial, misleading, and downright manipulative information that does nothing but increase anxiety and stress in our lives. Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the _Dobbs_ decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we will win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.

clean_body: This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream | | | = Let me lay this out, clear as day: I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024. This Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation. If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– = | = Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent. Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation. Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning. I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is. Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history: He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf. Purged independent watchdogs across government. Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents. Defied and threatened federal judges. Undermined the press. Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes. In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. | | I love my kids too much to let the tech oligarchs impose their agenda on my family. And I know you feel the same about yours. Every so-called “innovation” has been nothing more than a power grab—taking power from us, straight into their hands. And now, the tech elite has turned with rabid enthusiasm to artificial intelligence. Make no mistake: this isn’t about helping Americans—it’s about replacing them.
* AI-powered robots threaten to automate entire industries.
* Over 3.5 million trucking jobs wiped out with self-driving vehicles.
* Delivery drivers, taxi workers, and customer service reps—eliminated in the name of “efficiency.”
* Millions of entry-level jobs—gone overnight.

This isn’t progress. It’s the destruction of the working class. I’m Josh Hawley, and I’m leading the fight to stop Big Tech from stealing our children’s attention, personal data and their very future! But I refuse to stand by while powerful billionaires replace American workers and rob our kids of opportunity. Will you stand with me?

And together, we’re raising our kids—Elijah, Blaise, and Abigail—to know that their value comes not from Washington or woke ideology, but from God. Right now, I’m fighting the greatest threat to our families and our future: Big Tech. | | I love my kids too much to let the tech oligarchs impose their agenda on my family. And I know you feel the same about yours. Silicon Valley has run roughshod over modern civilization—and they’re just getting started. Smartphones addict our children. Social media tracks their every click, pause, and purchase. Every so-called “innovation” has been nothing more than a power grab—taking power from us, straight into their hands. And now, the tech elite has turned with rabid enthusiasm to artificial intelligence. Make no mistake: this isn’t about helping Americans—it’s about replacing them. AI-powered robots threaten to automate entire industries. Over 3.5 million trucking jobs wiped out with self-driving vehicles. Delivery drivers, taxi workers, and customer service reps—eliminated in the name of “efficiency.” Millions of entry-level jobs—gone overnight. This isn’t progress. It’s the destruction of the working class. I’m Josh Hawley, and I’m leading the fight to stop Big Tech from stealing our children’s attention, personal data and their very future! But I refuse to stand by while powerful billionaires replace American workers and rob our kids of opportunity. Will you stand with me? | | In Liberty, Josh Hawley | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Josh Hawley Victory Committee | | | | | | | | | |

Derek, let’s be clear:
Targeting Jerome Powell is just the latest escalation of Trump's corrupt weaponization of the government in his pursuit of unfettered power, and everyone should be paying attention to it.
The Department of Justice served the Federal Reserve with grand jury subpoenas, threatening a criminal indictment of Powell, ostensibly for testimony he gave to Congress about the costs of a Treasury Department construction project.
As Chairman Powell himself laid out, that was merely an excuse, a pretext, and the administration is threatening criminal charges because the Federal Reserve is doing its job: setting interest rates based on what it determines will serve the public rather than acceding to Trump’s demands.
_These actions will only weaken the economy, even as they threaten to chill and silence the president’s critics._

Peter, here’s where we stand before tonight’s pre-primary deadline:
**We still need to raise another $12,842 to reach our goal by midnight tonight.**
**[If you’re with me, can you rush a $5 contribution to help us get there?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260122_1_deadline.1E3u1j&refcode=em20260122-462&amount=5&t=1&akid=462%2E299639%2EHQugRp)**

Everywhere we look, we see the consequences of Greg Abbott’s leadership.
* Neighborhood schools are closing
* Health care costs are skyrocketing while Texas ranks near the bottom
* Property taxes are still high
* People are struggling to afford the basics

That’s why I’m running for Governor, Peter. Because Texans deserve better.
But I know this race won’t be easy. Our opponent has more than $100 million in his campaign account — and he’ll spend whatever it takes to try to bring us down.
It takes real courage to meet this moment and fight for a better future for our state. And if I’ve learned anything during my career, it’s that courage is contagious. That is the secret to beating right-wing billionaires and special interests — it’s our courage to never back down, even when we’re up against fierce opposition.
**I need your support now more than ever. Let’s prove we’re in this race to win it.**
**[It’s the final countdown to tonight’s pre-primary deadline. Chip in $5 now.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260122_1_deadline.1E3u1j&refcode=em20260122-462&amount=5&t=21&akid=462%2E299639%2EHQugRp)**
Thank you,
Gina

Team,

There are nine "Johns" in the Senate right now. There have only been five Black women — **_ever._**

While we're proud Lisa is among the short list of Black women who have been elected to the Senate, we're sad and frankly, disappointed, that — almost _**250 years**_ into our nation’s history — that number is still so low.

**Having people in the Senate who look like the rest of America matters.**

It's how resolutions like Black Women's Equal Pay Day, introduced by Senators Lisa Blunt Rochester and Angela Alsobrooks, get passed. Or how we make sure we advocate for Black maternal healthcare. And it's how we pass legislation honoring the late great John Lewis, expanding voting rights, and protecting people of color.

[**We need more women of color in the places where important decisions are being made. name: Tobias Read
subject: President Trump says there won't be an election in 2026. As the person in charge of Oregon elections, I will fight for you
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em]
This week, President Donald Trump said the quiet part out loud when he remarked, “We shouldn’t even have an election” in 2026.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em]
That’s not rhetoric. It’s a threat to democracy itself, and it fits a dangerous pattern: Trump’s DOJ has targeted vote-by-mail, demanded access to our private voter data, including Social Security numbers and driver’s license info, and tried to prosecute his political opponents. And he’s used federal troops and ICE agents to intimidate and harass those states that have stood up to him.
But here’s the good news: As Oregon’s Secretary of State, I have fought President Trump at every turn. And with your help, we’ve won:
✅ When they came after vote-by-mail, we fought back, and Oregon beat them in court.
✅ When they demanded access to our private voter data, we said no. And the court sided with us.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em]
But we know what’s coming next. President Trump is questioning whether elections should happen at all. If he can’t rig the system the way he wants, he's threatening to undermine the entire election itself.
Let me say this plainly: elections are not optional. They do not belong to any President. And they are not negotiable.
But these fights don’t end on their own. And they don’t defend themselves. If you believe elections should be decided by voters, I’m asking you to chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can to help my campaign reach voters across Oregon and communicate directly about what’s at stake. We need every tool in this fight, and shining a light on the Trump Administration’s efforts to undermine elections is critical. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260122em]
We’ve beaten them before because Oregonians trust and support our election system. And with your support, we will beat them again — and protect Oregon’s elections in 2026 and beyond.
Thank you for standing up for democracy,
Tobias Read
Secretary of State, Oregon

Hi — it’s Becca. **Last week, I got on a plane and went to Minnesota because people there were asking for help.** Real people. Families. Neighbors who are scared and still speaking up. They weren’t asking for attention — they were asking for someone to show up, listen, and say out loud what they’re living through. I sat in that hearing room and listened as one person after another told the truth about what’s happening. Immigrants, parents, young people, elders. **Folks who are scared, yes, but still brave enough to put their names and faces out there.** Some of them were taking real risks just to be heard. [_**Before I go any further, I want to be honest with you. I need your help. If you believe these folks deserve to be seen and protected, will you click here and chip in $5, $15, or whatever you can right now to help me keep showing up for them? # [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?t=1&akid=3883%2E898137%2EZvlGTK)
Friend,
Growing up, running for office was never on my radar.
But now that I’m here, I’ve learned so much — and I’m eager to share with you what goes on behind the scenes. Whether it’s through a chat over a beer on our brewery tour, Instagram Live updates, or your inbox, I want you involved in the journey, discovering alongside me how we can make a real impact.
One thing you may have picked up is that this isn’t your typical email program. **I want this to be more than just me telling you what I think matters — I want to know what you care about.**
**This is a team.** One of the most important things to me on this team is building trust. I made the decision at the outset of this campaign that we’re not taking any corporate PAC donations, knowing that was going to make it _much_ harder to fundraise.
I’m also not listening to a billionaire boys club tell us what we should prioritize and how we should build policy. _I want that to be driven by you._
**[My campaign has put together a winter priorities survey to learn more about what matters most to you. Your voice helps shape our priorities as we begin this critical election year. name: Wesley Bell
subject: Politicians shouldn't be able to make decisions about your body…but they're still trying.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
This is my promise to you all: Peter,

Today marks another anniversary of the original _Roe v. Wade_ decision — a reminder of what this country once recognized as a basic truth: **women deserve the freedom to make decisions about their own bodies, their own families, and dictate their own futures.**

But thanks to a small minority of anti-choice extremists, that freedom was ripped away in 2022 by the Supreme Court — leaving it up to each state to decide its own protection for abortion rights. In 2024, Missouri voters spoke up and voted to enshrine the right to an abortion in our state constitution. But just like with _Roe,_ Republicans across our state are determined to undo the will of the people.

Missouri's 2024 amendment gave us hope and said loud and clear that Americans deserve the right to make their own choices about their bodies without politicians looking over their shoulders. **Yet Republican lawmakers are pushing a confusing ballot measure that twists the truth, claiming it's about "exceptions" while really aiming to take away fundamental rights.**

This fight isn't just limited to Missouri — all across the country, states are using ballot measures to expand rights in some places and restrict them in others. But I want to be crystal clear about something, Peter: banning abortion doesn't stop abortion; it stops safe abortion. It forces people to travel, to wait, to put their health at risk, and it punishes the doctors who are just trying to do their jobs, _even in states with protections._

Courts, legislators, and politicians keep finding ways to chip away at access, rewrite the rules, and try to confuse voters. This anniversary isn't about celebrating a court decision made in 1973; it's about remembering the people who've been hurt, the providers silenced, and the generations who deserve better than lawmakers making decisions for them. Reproductive care IS healthcare, and no politician or judge should get to touch the choices you make about your own body. **End of story.**

[**I'll never stop fighting alongside my Democratic colleagues to restore the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ and ensure healthcare equality under the law. Yet Republican lawmakers are pushing a confusing ballot measure that twists the truth, claiming it's about "exceptions" while really aiming to take away fundamental rights. This fight isn't just limited to Missouri — all across the country, states are using ballot measures to expand rights in some places and restrict them in others. But I want to be crystal clear about something, Peter: banning abortion doesn't stop abortion; it stops safe abortion. It forces people to travel, to wait, to put their health at risk, and it punishes the doctors who are just trying to do their jobs, even in states with protections. Courts, legislators, and politicians keep finding ways to chip away at access, rewrite the rules, and try to confuse voters. This anniversary isn't about celebrating a court decision made in 1973; it's about remembering the people who've been hurt, the providers silenced, and the generations who deserve better than lawmakers making decisions for them. Reproductive care IS healthcare, and no politician or judge should get to touch the choices you make about your own body. End of story. In solidarity, Wesley | PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI PO Box 190669, ST LOUIS, MO 63119

We're not going back to the days before women's rights were protected.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123836508/596722846/-1473932214?refcode=logo&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDM4Y2QyMy1jY2Y3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cy7GG26so0mmMA6c1IYJJuUYHNUpRegSpRDCNZTNApU=) Folks, Many people don’t know that my mother lived a hard life. Born just before the great depression, she was widowed twice before she turned 40, and raised four children by herself. No matter how tight our budget, she always found something, even if it was only $20, to support Planned Parenthood. She deeply believed that the worst burden you could place on a young woman was forcing them to have a child that wasn’t planned and that they didn’t want. Beginning with her teaching, I have supported a woman’s right to choose my entire life. Fifty-three years ago, the Supreme Court affirmed that women have the right to make their own health care decisions. Today, we should be celebrating the anniversary of _Roe v. Wade._ Instead, we’re seeing the catastrophic impact of nearly four years since the Supreme Court took away the right of millions of women to make their own reproductive health care decisions. In the years since _Dobbs,_ we haven’t stopped fighting. We’ve pushed to repeal the Comstock Act to protect abortion medication access. We’ve introduced the Restoring Essential Healthcare Act to restore funding for Planned Parenthood. We’ve fought to keep Mifepristone legal and accessible so women can get the care they need. We’ve worked to protect easy access to affordable birth control. **Fifty-three years after Roe, we haven't given up the fight for reproductive freedom. Because reproductive rights are non-negotiable. Friend,
On this day 53 years ago, Roe v. Wade was decided, protecting the right to abortion and bringing our country out of a dark time.
After ⬇️ college, I helped organize reproductive rights and contraceptive care programs in underdeveloped countries, supporting them as they also tried to make progress like we had.

But what I saw there were the effects of what happens when the rights of women are thrown to the wayside or deemed politically unimportant.
And after Trump's Supreme Court overturned Roe, we became just like them.
States like Wisconsin allowed abortion laws from 1849 to go into effect and women in states like Texas were put in prison for miscarriages.
Friend, the cruel toxicity of partisan politics has turned an issue that's clear for a majority of Americans into a party line that cannot be crossed.
Republicans like our opponent want you to believe that abortion is a state's rights issue, it's not.
It's a human rights issue.
That's why we need to flip this seat and elect a bold voice who won't give up in the fight for reproductive freedom to Congress. subject: The Mountain Minute: 1/22/2026
body:
How Colorado’s caucus system works—and why the 2026 midterm elections start now
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado’s 2026 midterms are already taking shape as [caucuses approach](https://link.email.joinrmv.), creating an early window for grassroots voters who meet the deadlines. Courts dealt setbacks to local challenges, [rejecting Rep. Jason Crow’s bid to block ICE oversight rules](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and recommending dismissal of a lawsuit [challenging Colorado’s transgender athletics policies](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on procedural grounds. State regulators also moved toward potentially overriding El Paso County’s [rejection of Xcel power line permits](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while lawmakers warned [prison beds could run out by 2026](https://link.email.joinrmv.). A federal lawsuit against Northglenn over [churches cited for events in a public park](https://link.email.joinrmv.) added new religious freedom concerns.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Nationally, Tulsi Gabbard [condemned disruptions of a Minnesota church service](https://link.email.joinrmv.) by anti-ICE protesters as evidence of growing hostility toward religious freedom. At the same time, the Trump administration credited deportations with easing housing pressure, citing a [3.4% dip in Denver home prices](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as proof immigration enforcement can deliver economic relief.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Commentary contrasted Washington’s failures with local success, warning a [$1.8 trillion federal deficit is being driven by fraud and unchecked spending](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while pointing to Merit Academy in Woodland Park as proof [parent-led, community-driven education reform](https://link.email.joinrmv.) can succeed where top-down systems fail.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, January 22, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[How Colorado’s caucus system works—and why the 2026 midterm elections start now](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
If you’ve ever heard the word “caucus” and quietly thought, I’m not entirely sure what that actually means, you’re not alone.
Even Eric Trump has admitted he had to ask. While campaigning for his father during the 2016 election, he recalls turning to organizers and asking, “Can someone finally explain what this caucus is?”
The room laughed. Not at him—more in recognition. And relatable. A lot of politically engaged adults only learn what a caucus is once they’re already in the middle of politics—sometimes years into voting. Sometimes only after they’re standing in a room where decisions are being made. And sometimes even after they’ve gone a few times.
In Colorado, that late learning comes with consequences.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Trump Administration Credits Deportations for Denver Home Price Dip](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Home prices dip as enforcement ramps up:** The Trump administration says Denver’s median home listing price fell 3.4% year over year, attributing the decline to mass deportations easing housing demand in cities with large undocumented populations.
* **Immigration tied to affordability and safety:** In a news release, the administration argued deportations are freeing up housing, reducing strain on public resources, and restoring safety—prioritizing American citizens in tight housing markets like Denver.
* **Claims spark debate over policy impact:** While the administration did not provide detailed methodology, it named Denver among 14 cities where immigration enforcement coincided with falling home prices, reinforcing arguments that border and interior enforcement affect affordability.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Merit Academy: Undeniable Change, A Model For Our Next Victory](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY ERIC GIL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Parent-led choice beat bureaucratic resistance:** Merit Academy was launched after the Woodland Park School Board unanimously rejected it, forcing parents and founders to bypass district control through a lower-funded contract school pathway—proving demand for school choice despite institutional opposition.
* **Undeniable results followed freedom:** Despite starting in churches and a hardware store basement, Merit Academy rose to become one of Colorado’s top-ranked K–12 public schools, validating classical education, rigorous academics, and a values-driven culture.
* **A model for reform statewide:** The commentary argues Merit Academy’s success shows real education reform comes from parents and communities—not top-down mandates—and should be replicated across Colorado as enrollment drops and families lose confidence in traditional districts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**A new session, same defiance: How Colorado’s immigration policy put ideology over enforcement**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 20** _Colorado lawmakers are walking into the 2026 session with the budget already tight. They’re also bracing for more legal fights with Washington. New bills tied to ICE enforcement are moving early, including one that would expand the state’s ability to sue over immigration-related rights claims._
[**Homelessness Isn’t Just About Rent: Denver’s Spending Tells a Bigger Story**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | JANUARY 20** _Denver once bought a motel to help move people off the street. Two years later, it made headlines for trying to sell that same property for ten dollars. Denver’s homelessness debate almost always circles back to housing. Rents are high. Wages trail behind. Even when Denver adds housing, the gap doesn’t seem to close. From there, the “it’s housing” argument almost writes itself._ __
[**>From Misunderstanding to Malice. Why Conservatives Finally Speak Plainly**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 20** _For decades, many conservatives believed silence was a virtue. They assumed that if they spoke carefully, clearly, and charitably, they would be understood. When their views were mischaracterized as racist, cruel, or hateful, they often withdrew. Not because they agreed with the accusation, but because they did not want to be mistaken for something they were not._
__

Peter,
If Democrats reclaim the House next November the MAGA agenda hits a brick wall. Trump will become a lame duck president incapable of fulfilling any further policy goals. And right now a blue wave and a cataclysmic GOP defeat is exactly what we're on track for.
The only way MAGA can survive 2026 is if they rig the game.
Which is why in red states across the country, Trump is pushing for new congressional maps that will make up for the dozens of seats they are set to lose. A move that could establish one party rule for generations.

The GOP is moving fast. Gerrymandered maps have passed in Texas, North Carolina, Missouri, and a push for redistricting is underway in Indiana and Florida with more red states soon to follow.
This is an existential crisis. No matter how unpopular Trump becomes, if left unchecked, MAGA will create enough new red seats to ensure their House majority is insurmountable making it impossible for Dems to reclaim the House.
However, Americans are pushing back. Last month, California fired the opening blow of the Democratic counter-salvo with their vote to pass Proposition 50, a ballot measure that gives CA a fair congressional map to counter Trump's gerrymandering push.
But California alone won't be enough. To save our Democracy, blue states like Colorado must pick up the torch, join the fight, and meet this moment head on
This is why Colorado Draws the Line is proud to announce that we are introducing the ballot measure that will give every Coloradan a chance to vote on a new Congressional map that will make Colorado bluer.
We have the power to level the playing field and counter Trump's power grab with fair maps that will put power back in the hands of the people but it will require an astronomically expensive push to get this on the ballot and in front of Colorado voters.
MAGA is about to throw everything they've got into stopping us and we need to brace for impact. body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

First ICE murdered Renee Good, and now armed gangs of agents have taken
over Minneapolis. Yet as Americans rise up in protest, some Democrats are
considering rubber-stamping another year of funding for Trump's gangs.

Democrats finally have negotiating power ahead of the January 30 deadline
to fund the government. But unless we flood Congress with calls, moderate
Democrats could vote yes on funding ICE, while talking about body cameras
and training programs as if that would fix ICE's deep, systemic brutality.

Let's be clear: no amount of training will stop what Trump has deployed
ICE to do – terrorize, deport, and divide. We don't need more cameras – we
need ICE and Border Patrol out of our communities for good.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34969?source=email-20260122&t=1011&akid=10111%2E5885482%2EETNCEy ]Headline: Fury grows over Democrats who won't back ICE funding freeze

Right now, Democrats in Congress have the power – and the responsibility –
to stop the violence ICE inflicts on immigrant families and entire
communities. But we have to overwhelm them with public pressure to draw
the line.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34969?source=email-20260122&t=1012&akid=10111%2E5885482%2EETNCEy ]Add your name today to demand congressional Democrats OPPOSE all
funding for ICE and say NO to another penny for the Department of Homeland
Security's machinery of terror.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34969?source=email-20260122&t=1013&akid=10111%2E5885482%2EETNCEy ]ADD YOUR NAME

Federal agents are brutalizing protestors, communities are living in
constant fear, and a government agency has been unleashed on anyone who
dares to dissent. But Congress keeps writing the checks – using OUR
taxpayer dollars.

First, our progressive allies in Congress led the push alongside our
outside movement to stop funding ICE. Then we took your voices - and
signatures - to Schumer and Jeffries. Now, House Democratic leaders just
said they'd oppose the DHS funding bill – BUT! They also admitted they
won't actually whip votes against it. That leaves the door open for
“moderates” to join Republicans and to rubber stamp ICE's budget.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34969?source=email-20260122&t=1014&akid=10111%2E5885482%2EETNCEy ]Headline: House Democratic leaders will oppose DHS funding bill as
party rages over ICE

It's unacceptable that some Democrats are leaving the door open to sending
more of our tax dollars to fuel cruel ICE raids — rather than protecting
our communities from violence and abuse. When 75 Democratic leaders joined
Republicans to vote for a resolution *thanking ICE* for their work last
year, they turned their backs on the people. We can't let them do it
again.

We've seen what works: thousands of calls and emails demanding
accountability. Together, we can force Democrats to stop hiding behind
excuses and use their negotiating power to put a halt to ICE. Help us keep
up the pressure!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34969?source=email-20260122&t=1015&akid=10111%2E5885482%2EETNCEy ]Send Congress an immediate email DEMANDING THEY OPPOSE any funding for
ICE or DHS. No more half measures. No more blank checks. We demand real
courage, real protection for our communities, and real action today.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34969?source=email-20260122&t=1016&akid=10111%2E5885482%2EETNCEy ]ADD YOUR NAME

Let's make Congress feel the heat – because if we don't, they will keep
fueling ICE's reign of terror with our tax dollars.

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

I’m ready to be that governor!

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: ICE denied me entry.
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260122-1853-foote&t=1001&akid=1853%2E342411%2Epw1Gae ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter — I
recently went down to an ICE federal facility in Minneapolis to conduct
oversight as a member of Congress and seek accountability as ICE
terrorizes my community.

What happened next will not surprise you:

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260122-movement.Edn_aS&refcode=em20260122-1853&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1853%2E342411%2Epw1Gae ]Tweet from Ilhan Omar: 'I was just denied access to the ICE processing
center at the Whipple Building. Members of Congress have a legal right and
constitutional responsibility to conduct oversight where people are being
detained. The public deserves to know what is taking place in ICE
facilities.'

This is a blatant and illegal attempt to obstruct members of Congress from
doing their job. And it’s just another example of ICE acting as a runaway,
unaccountable, secret police force operating outside of the law.

They don’t answer to Congress. They don’t answer to the Courts. They don’t
answer to state officials or law enforcement. And they certainly don’t
answer to the American people, who they have harassed, detained, beaten,
and shot at on a daily basis.

No, ICE answers only to the President. They’re a squad of personal thugs
ready to be unleashed on the President's political opponents.

Just look at how they have refused to cooperate with Minnesota on an
investigation into the murder of Renee Good. They care more about
protecting their own than seeking truth, justice, and accountability for
an American citizen who was killed in cold blood.

It’s fascism, it’s authoritarianism, and the American people cannot and
will not stand for it.

If we are to protect our democracy as we slide down this slippery slope,
it’s absolutely imperative that we meet MAGA and the far-right in every
state and every district across the country with a tidal wave of
opposition.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260122-movement.Edn_aS&refcode=em20260122-1853&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1853%2E342411%2Epw1Gae ]Please, chip in to the Squad Victory Fund to power our movement as we
fight back in Minneapolis and work to protect our neighbors from ICE’s
attacks.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260122-movement.Edn_aS&refcode=em20260122-1853&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1853%2E342411%2Epw1Gae ]Contribute ››

We all have a role to play in building the movement to end this insanity.

I will continue to do what I can, with all the power I have as a member of
Congress, to fight back. I’m counting on you to do your part too, and help
us defeat Trump’s extreme agenda and out-of-control presidency.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260122-movement.Edn_aS&refcode=em20260122-1853&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1853%2E342411%2Epw1Gae ]DONATE NOW

body:
Here's what's happening in the Forward world...

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_86a&n=1)
---
Thursday, January 22, 2026 | Peter -- A new [Gallup poll ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=cCJNx_i1q-s1JjGee0i8mzqG2VwgaAbo0yuBiUgRrFvvbOp3CePGLHpGFxrhPQfChqkdFtc10pK9wcWkCuwIhABDkpPCcBZbUgmjJge55De3DsVxsgzMbSoETKDj98m4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_86a&n=2)shows that 45 percent of Americans now identify as political independents, representing the largest single political identity in the country. Younger voters are leading this shift, with majorities of Gen Z and millennials choosing not to align with either major party. Millions of Americans no longer feel represented by the traditional Republican and Democratic labels. This growing independent majority reflects deep frustration with a political system that seems more focused on party loyalty than solving real, everyday problems. That frustration shows up across other national polling as well. A [New York Times/Siena survey](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=uGtnHBrUwtdPxj-RT-kjBwE54tFe4o_jw2UD-w-OS1MWim3kfJot6fsvtHYUL0gw10q5_sDxXvGUCdlE0k8_o2zzMH3gbFR4z91lYlsRHNgdQZh49wiPDoMl-5BQ6z1FQ-TXnPIbOHnBzlL-hAQWsc4zfZ-qKEIsGEpbw9QpYaYXDPLttyqnGYrRNxXACj4C&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_86a&n=3) released on January 22 shows President Trump’s job approval is underwater, with more voters disapproving than approving of his performance. A majority of respondents say the country is worse off now than a year ago and express broad dissatisfaction with leadership. These trends underscore a widespread hunger for alternatives to the familiar partisan battles that have dominated American politics. This widespread dissatisfaction has created a powerful opportunity for the Forward Party. As more Americans reject the two-party duopoly, Forward is building the infrastructure to offer a genuine alternative rooted in collaboration, transparency, and problem solving. Forward now has ballot access in seven states and is working to expand that access even further this year, enabling more voters to see Forward candidates directly on their ballots. Even before the end of January, the party has already received endorsement applications from more than **100 prospective candidates** for the 2026 cycle, a remarkable level of interest so early in the year. This growing roster reflects the fact that Americans are ready for leaders who put people over party politics. Forward is working from the ground up, launching new state chapters, securing ballot lines, and recruiting candidates who are committed to practical solutions and accountable governance. If you are tired of toxic politics and frustrated by gridlock, you are not alone. You are part of a growing majority that wants leaders who listen to their communities and focus on problem solving. Forward is here to turn that frustration into lasting reform and to build a political movement that works for everyday people, not for party bosses. **The Forward Party Team**
* * *
**[Minnesota Gubernatorial Candidate Mike Newcome](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=_KeSraPW0gSlxEBMOvJrEouH4SjeZmYtvTWulgNFAfYgXTtkkTVWf62GYCkgUdpL&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_86a&n=4) | Andrew Yang Podcast** On this episode, Andrew hosts independent and Forward Party candidate for governor of Minnesota, Mike Newcome. Mike argues that both major parties have failed ordinary citizens through corruption, mismanagement, and polarization. He highlights issues like the $250 million COVID-era fraud scandal and the divisive response to ICE raids, calling for “common-sense leadership” that prioritizes solutions over partisanship. **[A Third Party Senator, a 'teacher of the year' and an 'ordinary citizen.' Meet Utah's new lawmakers](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=rtTPSgvEp6UWncw5WXVsjEO-pY6qh4f5kKjxA9KAY7ht4Hiv8KOgqB1ItL_SwTMmFi2mTc4uABkKjT78fv052Vfz4S8df3YJG30VDJHJAuuxN6U1AUa9Ga8AJy37Tgzk&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_86a&n=5) | Utah News Dispatch** Students at Duke recently formed a chapter of the Forward Party. Yang, now the party’s co-chair, visited Duke Law School Monday to meet with a group of those student leaders, as well as 10 North Carolina Forward Party representatives, to discuss the future of the party at the University, in North Carolina and across the country.
[**Recruitment Challenge**](https://home.forwardparty.com/recruitment_challenge?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fast_forward_86a&n=6) The midterm year is upon us and we need as many voters and volunteers as possible to support the incredible candidates we endorse this year! Join Carrie Anne, our Head of Volunteer Programs, to learn how to help us recruit more supporters. We will go over how to talk about Forward with your friends and family, and how to share your recruitment link so you can earn points that are redeemable for items in our merch shop! **If you’re tired of waiting for the system to fix itself — this is your moment.** **

Meanwhile, equal shares of U.S. adults — 27% each — identified as either Democrats or Republicans. In most years since Gallup began regularly conducting its polls by telephone in 1988, independents have been the largest political group. However, the independent percentage has increased markedly in the past 15 years, typically registering 40% or higher, a level not reached prior to 2011.

body:
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out.

| Peter

Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders.

In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging.

**Just recently, I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.**

This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year.

I'm a lawyer, and today I want to talk to you about a case that changed millions of lives.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123838460/596729956/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YWY2YjAyNi1kMWY3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=____3emwik9Bk79j7eTKZKrNUNezE8oSXOzMyySxDso=)

Peter,

I'm a lawyer, and today I want to talk to you about a case that changed millions of lives: _Roe v. Wade._

It began with a young, unmarried woman who was pregnant and wanted a chance at a different future. At the time, abortion was illegal in 44 states, including the one where she lived. Her options were grim. If she had money, she could travel to one of the few states where abortion was legal. If she didn't, she could be forced to carry the pregnancy to term or risk her life by turning to a back-alley provider.

**In 1973, her case reached the Supreme Court. And on this day, the Court ruled in her favor!_Roe v. Wade_ established a constitutional right to abortion grounded in the fundamental rights to privacy and personal liberty.**

Today, that protection is gone. Since _Roe_ was overturned, our country has taken a _massive_ step backward.

Here in Iowa, women face a six-week abortion ban, before most people barely miss a period. Some are able to travel out of state, but many cannot. Those who can't are left navigating a collapsing reproductive healthcare system thanks to politicians like Mariannatte Miller-Meeks.

Our anti-abortion laws have placed OB-GYNs under constant legal surveillance, turning routine pregnancy care into a legal minefield. The result is devastating: Iowa is facing a shortage of OB-GYNs, especially in rural communities, at the very moment families need care the most.

And instead of addressing this crisis, Mariannette Miller-Meeks has doubled down. She voted for the “Big, Ugly Bill,” ensuring deep cuts to Medicaid that disproportionately harm rural Iowa. She has stood behind her party's agenda to control women's bodies, even going so far as to co-sponsor a national abortion ban.

It is time to once again protect abortion in Iowa. It is time to place abortion back between a woman and her doctor, not politicians and judges.

**[That is what I will fight for in Congress. And if you believe our daughters, sisters, friends, and neighbors deserve the freedom to decide their own futures, I hope you'll stand with me and make a donation to my campaign>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123838461/596729957/-2011951990?refcode=em26_260122_FRabor_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260122_FRabor_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=6af6b026-d1f7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YWY2YjAyNi1kMWY3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=____3emwik9Bk79j7eTKZKrNUNezE8oSXOzMyySxDso=)**

Thank you,

Christina

subject: On Roe's anniversary, I want you to know where I stand.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress
body:
It shouldn't be controversial to say that there’s no room for politicians in the exam room. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123838763/596730722/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMmM0MWE5My1kMWY3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XftQbCNo7XpPQkbgX7DM8qNySFVk-wtWw5FA-er0aS0=&emci=76d7eaa9-b4f7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=d2c41a93-d1f7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter,

Today marks the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s _Roe v. Wade_ decision—a landmark case that affirmed a woman's right to abortion care and her right to privacy in medical decision-making.

For decades, _Roe_ meant that women could make deeply personal healthcare choices without political interference. But even with that protection in place, **access was never guaranteed.**

Women were harassed outside of clinics.

Doctors were pressured and threatened.

Activist lawmakers chipped away at _Roe_ at every opportunity, passing restrictions designed to make care harder to get, especially for low-income women and women in rural communities. These were medically unnecessary restrictions, like hallway width, waiting periods, and proximity to a hospital, even though abortion is less risky than wisdom tooth extraction.

**And then, a GOP-stacked Supreme Court did what anti-abortion politicians had been working toward for years. With the _Dobbs v. Jackson_ decision, _Roe_ was overturned—and millions of women lost a fundamental right overnight.**

But let me be clear, Peter: I'm a doctor. I believe in healthcare access, ALL healthcare, for every American. Why a woman wants an abortion is no one's business but her own. Full stop. It should always be a decision made between a patient and her doctor, _not dictated by politicians._

Far too many lawmakers have made it their personal mission to insert themselves into these conversations, but I want you to know exactly where I stand:

I will always stand for abortion rights.

clean_body: It shouldn't be controversial to say that there’s no room for politicians in the exam room. Peter, Today marks the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s Roe v. Wade decision—a landmark case that affirmed a woman's right to abortion care and her right to privacy in medical decision-making. For decades, Roe meant that women could make deeply personal healthcare choices without political interference. But even with that protection in place, access was never guaranteed. Women were harassed outside of clinics. Doctors were pressured and threatened. Activist lawmakers chipped away at Roe at every opportunity, passing restrictions designed to make care harder to get, especially for low-income women and women in rural communities. These were medically unnecessary restrictions, like hallway width, waiting periods, and proximity to a hospital, even though abortion is less risky than wisdom tooth extraction. And then, a GOP-stacked Supreme Court did what anti-abortion politicians had been working toward for years. With the Dobbs v. Jackson decision, Roe was overturned—and millions of women lost a fundamental right overnight. But let me be clear, Peter: I'm a doctor. I believe in healthcare access, ALL healthcare, for every American. Why a woman wants an abortion is no one's business but her own. Full stop. It should always be a decision made between a patient and her doctor, not dictated by politicians. Far too many lawmakers have made it their personal mission to insert themselves into these conversations, but I want you to know exactly where I stand: I will always stand for abortion rights. I will always stand with women. | | Peter – Today, on what would have been the 53rd anniversary of _Roe v. Wade_ , women’s health and reproductive care are still endangered.

**Anti-choice extremists are still set on banning safe and effective medication abortion pills, Planned Parenthood lost federal Medicaid funding thanks to the GOP’s unpopular budget bill, and just this month House leadership quietly slashed IVF coverage for military servicemembers.**

On top of the patchwork of varying abortion restrictions that exist in a post-_Roe_ America, the health and lives of countless women are on the line.

Without access to safe reproductive care, patients face risk of serious complications and even death. And when it comes down to it, this is a personal decision that should be made between a woman, her doctor, and her family.

Abortion is a matter of healthcare and privacy, and I won’t stop fighting for the freedom to make the best choice for ourselves and our families.

Every one of us lives with tension - the tug-of-war between the two of us living in all of us. In DIVIDED, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer gets real, raw, and deeply relatable as he opens up about his own struggles with pride, anger, and failure while chasing God's purpose. Through humor, honesty, and hard-learned wisdom, Lahmeyer invites readers to drop the mask, confront the "dark me" that keeps surfacing, and experience the transforming power of grace. This is not a polished preacher's pep talk-it's a gut-level, heart-to-heart conversation about what it means to follow Jesus when life gets messy. Drawing from the lives of biblical characters like Peter, Jacob and Paul, Lahmeyer shows that even the greatest heroes of faith had moments of weakness, doubt, and defeat. He unpacks the difference between remorse and repentance, explores how belief shapes behavior, and reveals how identity-not effort-is the key to lasting transformation. With vivid stories, relatable honesty, and the truth of Scripture, he reminds us that God isn't looking for the perfect version of you-He's after the real you. Because the moment you get real with God is the moment He starts making you new. If you've ever felt like you're living two lives-the public you that looks strong and the private you that's barely hanging on-this book is for you. DIVIDED will help you see that failure isn't final, temptation isn't sin, and your past doesn't disqualify your purpose. You'll laugh, you'll be challenged, and you'll find hope in the God who meets you where you are but never leaves you there. Honest, gritty, and full of grace, this book will inspire you to feed the right wolf, renew your mind, and finally live as the "you" God designed you to be.

| Good news to kick off the year:

Last month, the Michigan Senate and House *unanimously* passed my bills with Senator Mallory McMorrow to help keep kids safe from active shooters.

It isn’t easy to get any bill through committee in a divided Legislature, let alone with no opposition. But by the end of the year, we got it done and Governor Gretchen Whitmer signed it into law. **✅**

Here’s what we did:
**🔒** Last term, we changed the fire and building codes to allow for automatic door locks in schools in the event of an emergency in the building.
**👶** Now, we’re expanding that protection to include those inside childcare centers.

This may not grab national headlines — but it matters, especially to kids, teachers, and providers who are confronted with the tragic situation of an active shooter. Because protecting kids shouldn’t be controversial.

This is just one more way I’m working to keep our communities safe — from early childhood centers to classrooms to Congress.

clean_body: It isn’t easy to get any bill through committee in a divided Legislature, let alone with no opposition. But by the end of the year, we got it done and Governor Gretchen Whitmer signed it into law. ✅ | = | Good news to kick off the year: Last month, the Michigan Senate and House unanimously passed my bills with Senator Mallory McMorrow to help keep kids safe from active shooters. It isn’t easy to get any bill through committee in a divided Legislature, let alone with no opposition. But by the end of the year, we got it done and Governor Gretchen Whitmer signed it into law. ✅ Here’s what we did: 🔒 Last term, we changed the fire and building codes to allow for automatic door locks in schools in the event of an emergency in the building. 👶 Now, we’re expanding that protection to include those inside childcare centers. This may not grab national headlines — but it matters, especially to kids, teachers, and providers who are confronted with the tragic situation of an active shooter. Because protecting kids shouldn’t be controversial. This is just one more way I’m working to keep our communities safe — from early childhood centers to classrooms to Congress. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Grateful to be in this fight with you 💙 — Jeremy * | | = Paid for by Jeremy Moss for Congress Jeremy Moss for Congress 2211 S Telegraph Rd PO Box 7023 Bloomfield Hills, MI 48302 United States | | | ---|---|--- = =

name: Beto O'Rourke (via LeftNet)
subject: We’re showing up everywhere
body:
We have a Democrat on the ballot in every race in Texas. Now, we need to have their backs.
#
Powered by People has spent the last few months recruiting candidates to run for offices up and down the ballot. We’ve worked the phones, talked to community leaders about what it’s like to run, and drove across the state to hold in-person recruitment events at bars, in church meeting rooms, and in community centers.
**The goal? To have a Democrat on the ballot for every State House, State Senate, and Congressional race so we compete everywhere.**
_Take a look at the results:_
* **U.S. House:** Democrats filed to run for 38 out of 38 seats
* **State Senate:** Democrats filed to run for 16 out of 16 seats
* **State House:** Democrats filed to run for 150 out of 150 seats

This is unheard of in Texas. But it’s not enough to simply have a Democrat on the ballot in every race. Now, we need to have their backs.
**[Will you add your name to support our organizing and voter registration program so that we can compete in and win races up and down the ballot in 2026?](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22166?t=1&akid=1472%2E2118727%2E1VgX1x)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22166?t=2&akid=1472%2E2118727%2E1VgX1x)**
At Powered by People, we don’t just talk about the work. We don’t just think about the work. We _do_ the work. We’re registering voters, deploying trained volunteers, holding community events, organizing on college campuses, and building the people-powered movement necessary to win in the most voter suppressed state.
[**Add your name today to join our movement and help us keep doing the work.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22166?t=3&akid=1472%2E2118727%2E1VgX1x)
Thank you,
Beto

| Peter,
In the wake of Renee Good's murder by an ICE agent in Minnesota, MAGA has been quick to spin the narrative, defend the killer, and blame the victim.
But Lauren Boebert took it to a whole new level of delusion, retweeting a post by right-wing extremist and Virginia legislator Nick Freitas who claims Democrats begged for Renee Good to be murdered:
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001W513Xk3jQzdPv6ssOBQ1BcJvWSTqsizHNcxaRpUGOWxC2e0-VfGqqSMnpwlw1wz9uJHtmzUL7a8Nu1oOThNvwxFq2tN9h6uQ0LRij20N55Cz6DWLhL5yG73ptRXWLyRMbNsHm-qVjiU8FbMvKJdvB04D4KjMdTKFG5x3HZIPdoHTYBawTHcDgZ7BCDwt8uf1qPbLWnQnL0aETUlGBRjUMg7-mAgLIP_2&c=WwD0mwYuFCqBPI0ssIjeSwaHZxw_1xyfmmltyXe-2yZA5BXEyQTecQ==&ch=oeKNrZkT8lw3RLFyJAQ0xB8oKKyqwFg1HQURgD5frJLtHoxZVj7N-Q==)

This is sickening.
The video is public and clear as day, Renee Good was not attempting to harm the ICE agents with her vehicle. A recently released autopsy report suggests the fatal shot was the third and final shot, which the video recording shows was taken from the side of the vehicle while Renee's vehicle was clearly passing by the unharmed agent.
Boebert is essentially claiming Democrats sacrificed the life of a mother and orphaned a child just so ICE would receive negative media attention. It's something only a deeply deranged person would come up with.
And it's not just her words, but her actions too. Boebert is a member of the House Oversight Committee--the Congressional committee whose primary responsibility is to hold agencies like ICE accountable. Instead of doing her job, Boebert voted to block a measure that would have required ICE to release footage, videos, and documents related to the killing.
We have to restore sanity to Congress. Politicians like Boebert who only view politics as a team sport, devoid of any convictions, morality, or sense of duty, are destroying this nation.

Team, I’m suing the Department of Homeland Security to stop their dangerous, illegal, and unconstitutional operation in Minnesota. Thousands of armed, masked, and poorly trained federal agents are terrorizing the Twin Cities. They’ve brazenly and repeatedly used excessive force against Minnesotans, arrested and threatened innocent bystanders, and conducted militarized raids in schools, churches, hospitals, and other sensitive locations. This violates the law, the First and Tenth Amendment, and the Constitution’s guarantee of equal sovereignty. No one should be stopped, questioned, or targeted by ICE solely because of how they look, how they speak, or where they come from. No parent should have to wonder if their child will come home safely from school. body:
No President should be able to use military action without congressional approval.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260122-5835-footer&t=1&akid=5835%2E420207%2E_-aTNd)
Peter,
Brave service members risk everything when they are sent abroad — and they deserve to know their lives are not being gambled away without accountability.
When our government spends taxpayer dollars on unauthorized military action, it isn’t just a violation of the law. It’s a betrayal of the priorities families here at home are counting on, like safe schools, strong hospitals, and reliable infrastructure.
The American people need leaders who respect the Constitution and do not send service members into danger without debate, transparency, and a vote from Congress.
That’s why Congress must reassert its authority and rein in the President’s unchecked war powers. **No president, including Donald Trump, should be able to escalate military action on their own and drag our country into another forever war.**
My colleagues and I are pushing for War Powers Resolutions right now to stop the next generation of endless conflict and restore real accountability, but we need your help.
**[Peter, will you add your name to demand Congress say no to forever wars and yes to a safer, more prosperous future? Your voice will help us keep the pressure on.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/pj-em-20260122/?source=20260122-5835&t=2&akid=5835%2E420207%2E_-aTNd)**
